weeks.title: Positive-term series: comparison and integral tests
weeks.summary: Is week aap positive terms wali series ki convergence comparison, limit comparison aur integral test se check karoge, p-series ko benchmark ki tarah use karoge, aur integral se partial sum ka error estimate nikaloge.
concepts: **Positive-term series**: agar har aₙ ≥ 0 hai to partial sums Sₙ sirf badhte hain (monotonic). Isliye Σ aₙ converge karti hai tabhi jab Sₙ bounded ho. Is week ke saare tests isi ek idea par khade hain — har test bas Sₙ ko upar se baandhne ka tareeka hai.

**p-series**: Σ 1/nᵖ converge karti hai sirf p > 1 par, aur p ≤ 1 par diverge. Σ 1/n² converge (sum π²/6), Σ 1/n aur Σ 1/√n diverge. Ye hamara main benchmark hai — naye series ko isi se compare karenge. Geometric series Σ rⁿ (|r| < 1) doosra benchmark hai.

**Direct comparison test**: 0 ≤ aₙ ≤ bₙ (kuch n ke baad). Badi wali Σ bₙ converge ⇒ chhoti Σ aₙ bhi converge. Chhoti wali diverge ⇒ badi bhi diverge. Dhyan do: 'chhoti series diverge karti hai' ya 'badi converge karti hai' se kuch nahi milta jab direction ulti ho.

**Limit comparison test**: aₙ, bₙ > 0 aur L = lim aₙ/bₙ. Agar 0 < L < ∞ to dono series saath-saath converge ya diverge karti hain. Practical trick: aₙ me numerator aur denominator ki sabse badi powers rakho — (3n + 1)/(n³ + 4) ≈ 3n/n³ = 3/n², to bₙ = 1/n² lo.

**Integral test**: agar f(x) positive, continuous aur decreasing hai (x ≥ N ke liye) aur aₙ = f(n), to Σ aₙ aur ∫_N^∞ f(x) dx ya to dono converge ya dono diverge. Isi se p-series ka result aata hai, aur Σ 1/(n ln n) diverge, Σ 1/(n (ln n)²) converge — ln wale terms ke liye ye sabse kaam ka test hai.

**Integral se error estimate**: integral test ki shartein poori hon to remainder Rₙ = S − Sₙ ke liye ∫ₙ₊₁^∞ f dx ≤ Rₙ ≤ ∫ₙ^∞ f dx. Jaise Σ 1/n³ me R₁₀ ≤ ∫₁₀^∞ dx/x³ = 1/200. Engineering me yahi batata hai ki computer ko kitne terms jodne padenge taaki answer tolerance ke andar ho.

**Test choose karne ki strategy**: pehle nth-term test (aₙ ↛ 0 ⇒ diverge). Rational/algebraic terms ⇒ limit comparison with p-series. ln n wale terms ⇒ integral test. Factorials ya cⁿ ⇒ ratio test (Math for Electronics I wala). Test inconclusive aaye to doosra try karo — conclusion kabhi guess mat karo.

example.problem: Σ (n = 1 se ∞) (3n + 1)/(n³ + 4) converge karti hai ya nahi? Aur Σ 1/n³ ke liye kitne terms jodne padenge taaki integral bound ke hisaab se error 0.001 se kam ho?
steps: Pehli series: badi powers dekho — (3n + 1)/(n³ + 4) ≈ 3n/n³ = 3/n². To bₙ = 1/n² lo.
L = lim [(3n + 1)/(n³ + 4)]·n² = lim (3n³ + n²)/(n³ + 4) = 3. Ye 0 aur ∞ ke beech hai.
Σ 1/n² converge karti hai (p = 2 > 1), isliye limit comparison se di gayi series bhi **converge** karti hai.
Doosra sawaal: f(x) = 1/x³ positive, continuous, decreasing hai, to Rₙ ≤ ∫ₙ^∞ dx/x³ = 1/(2n²).
Answer: series **converge** karti hai, aur Σ 1/n³ ke **23 terms** jodne se error 0.001 se kam guaranteed hai.

mistakes: Comparison ki direction ulti lagana: 'aₙ ≤ bₙ aur Σ bₙ diverge, isliye Σ aₙ diverge' — galat. Chhoti series ke baare me badi divergent series kuch nahi batati. Ya to limit comparison lo, ya sahi direction wali inequality dhoondo.
Integral test ka answer series ka sum samajh lena. ∫₁^∞ dx/x² = 1, par Σ 1/n² = π²/6 ≈ 1.645. Integral sirf converge/diverge batata hai aur error ko baandhta hai, sum nahi deta.
Integral test lagane se pehle check na karna ki f decreasing hai. Jaise sin² wale ya oscillating terms par seedha integral test lagana galat hai.
revision: Σ 1/nᵖ: p > 1 converge, p ≤ 1 diverge.
0 ≤ aₙ ≤ bₙ: Σ bₙ converge ⇒ Σ aₙ converge; Σ aₙ diverge ⇒ Σ bₙ diverge.
Limit comparison: 0 < lim aₙ/bₙ < ∞ ⇒ same fate.
Integral test: f positive, continuous, decreasing.
Error: ∫ₙ₊₁^∞ f ≤ Rₙ ≤ ∫ₙ^∞ f.

questions.question: p-series Σ (n = 1 se ∞) 1/nᵖ inme se kis value par converge karti hai?
questions.explanation: p-series sirf p > 1 par converge karti hai, aur 1.01 > 1 hai — chahe 1 ke kitna bhi paas ho. p = 1 harmonic series hai jo diverge karti hai (sabse common trap). p = 1/2 aur p = 0 par terms aur bhi bade hain, to diverge.

questions.question: Σ (n = 1 se ∞) 1/(n² + 5) ke baare me kaunsa statement sahi hai?
options: Converge karti hai aur sum exactly π²/6 hai
Comparison test kuch nahi bata sakta, kyunki terms Σ 1/n² se chhote hain
Converge karti hai, kyunki 0 < 1/(n² + 5) ≤ 1/n² aur Σ 1/n² converge karti hai
questions.explanation: Chhote positive terms ki series, ek convergent series se neeche hai, to direct comparison se converge. Sum π²/6 se kam hoga (har term chhota hai), isliye 'exactly π²/6' galat. Chhota hona hi to wo case hai jahan comparison convergence deta hai — wo 'kuch nahi bata sakta' wala option direction ka confusion hai.

questions.question: Σ (n = 1 se ∞) (2n² + 1)/(n⁴ + 3n) ko bₙ = 1/n² se limit-compare karo. L = lim aₙ/bₙ aur conclusion kya hai?
questions.explanation: aₙ/bₙ = (2n⁴ + n²)/(n⁴ + 3n) → 2 (leading coefficients ka ratio). 0 < 2 < ∞ aur Σ 1/n² converge, to di gayi series bhi converge. L = 1/2 ratio ulta lene se aata hai (bₙ/aₙ) — conclusion same rehta par L galat hai. L = 0 tab aata jab galti se bₙ = 1/n lete.

questions.question: Inme se kaunsi series (n = 2 se ∞) converge karti hai?
questions.explanation: Integral test: u = ln x lo, ∫ dx/(x (ln x)²) = −1/ln x, jo ∞ par finite hai ⇒ converge. ∫ dx/(x ln x) = ln(ln x) → ∞, to Σ 1/(n ln n) diverge — terms 1/n se thode hi chhote hain, utna kaafi nahi. (ln n)/n ≥ 1/n (n ≥ 3) aur 1/√n p = 1/2 wali p-series hai, dono diverge.

questions.question: S = Σ (n = 1 se ∞) 1/n³ ko S₁₀ (pehle 10 terms ka sum) se approximate kiya. Integral test ke hisaab se error R₁₀ = S − S₁₀ ka upper bound kya hai?
questions.explanation: R₁₀ ≤ ∫₁₀^∞ dx/x³ = [−1/(2x²)]₁₀^∞ = 1/200 = 0.005. 0.001 = 1/10³ sirf agla term a₁₀ ka size hai, poore tail ka bound nahi (tail me a₁₁, a₁₂, ... sab hain). 0.01 = 1/10² me integral ka 1/2 bhool gaye. (Actual error ≈ 0.0045, jo bound ke andar hai.)

questions.question: Σ (n = 1 se ∞) 1/n⁴ ko computer par Sₙ se approximate karna hai. Integral bound Rₙ ≤ ∫ₙ^∞ dx/x⁴ ke hisaab se kam se kam kitne terms chahiye taaki error 10⁻⁶ se kam ho?
questions.explanation: ∫ₙ^∞ dx/x⁴ = 1/(3n³). Chahiye 1/(3n³) < 10⁻⁶ ⇒ n³ > 333334 ⇒ n > 69.3, to n = 70 (69³ = 328509 kam padta hai, 70³ = 343000 ✓). 100 tab aata hai jab 1/3 bhool ke n³ > 10⁶ lo. 32 tab jab sirf aakhri term 1/n⁴ < 10⁻⁶ maang lo — par error poora tail hai, ek term nahi.

questions.question: Σ (n = 1 se ∞) n/(2n + 1) ke baare me kya sahi hai?
questions.explanation: nth-term test: aₙ = n/(2n + 1) → 1/2, jo 0 nahi hai, to series diverge (har term lagbhag 1/2 jud raha hai, Sₙ ≈ n/2). 'aₙ < 1/2' ya 'bounded' hona convergence ke liye kaafi nahi — terms ka 0 par jaana zaroori hai. aₙ ≤ 1/n wali inequality hi galat hai, aur kisi divergent series se chhota hona waise bhi divergence nahi deta.

questions.question: Σ (n = 1 se ∞) 1/n^(0.9) ke baare me kya sahi hai?
questions.explanation: p-series 1/nᵖ sirf p > 1 par converge karti hai; p = 0.9 ≤ 1, to diverge (terms 1/n se bhi bade hain). 'Terms → 0' sirf zaroori shart hai, kaafi nahi — harmonic series me bhi terms 0 jaate hain. 'p > 0' galat benchmark hai, aur 1 ke paas hona kuch nahi badalta: boundary p = 1 khud divergent hai.

questions.question: 0 ≤ aₙ ≤ bₙ har n ke liye, aur Σ aₙ converge karti hai. Σ bₙ ke baare me kya keh sakte hain?
options: Σ bₙ zaroor converge karti hai
Σ bₙ zaroor diverge karti hai
Σ bₙ = Σ aₙ hi hoga
questions.explanation: Comparison sirf do directions me kaam karta hai: badi converge ⇒ chhoti converge, aur chhoti diverge ⇒ badi diverge. Yahan chhoti series converge hai, jo badi ke baare me kuch nahi batati: aₙ = 1/n², bₙ = 1/n lo to Σ bₙ diverge, aur bₙ = 2/n² lo to converge. Isliye 'zaroor converge' aur 'zaroor diverge' dono galat — ye ulti direction wala trap hai.

questions.question: Σ (n = 1 se ∞) √n/(n² + 1) ke liye kaunsa comparison aur conclusion sahi hai?
questions.explanation: Badi powers: √n/n² = 1/n^(3/2), to bₙ = 1/n^(3/2) lo: aₙ/bₙ = n²/(n² + 1) → 1, aur p = 3/2 > 1 ⇒ converge. 1/√n ya 1/n se L = 0 aata hai, aur L = 0 ke saath divergent bₙ se kuch nahi milta — 'diverge' conclusion galat hai. 1/n² se L = ∞, aur convergent bₙ ke saath L = ∞ bhi inconclusive hai.

questions.question: Σ (n = 1 se ∞) n·e^(−n²) par integral test lagao. ∫₁^∞ x·e^(−x²) dx ki value aur conclusion kya hai?
questions.explanation: u = x² se ∫ x e^(−x²) dx = −e^(−x²)/2, to ∫₁^∞ = e⁻¹/2 = 1/(2e) ≈ 0.184, finite ⇒ converge (f x ≥ 1 par positive aur decreasing hai). 1/e me substitution ka 1/2 chhoot gaya. Integral ki value series ka sum nahi hoti — sum ≈ 0.405 hai (pehla term hi e⁻¹ ≈ 0.368 hai). ∞ tab aata jab e^(−x²) ka tezi se girna ignore karo.

questions.question: Σ (n = 1 se ∞) 1/n² ke liye S₁₀ ≈ 1.5498 hai. Integral test ke dono bounds (remainder ke neeche aur upar wale) use karke S kis interval me aata hai?
questions.explanation: ∫₁₁^∞ dx/x² = 1/11 ≈ 0.0909 ≤ R₁₀ ≤ ∫₁₀^∞ dx/x² = 1/10. To 1.5498 + 0.0909 = 1.6407 ≤ S ≤ 1.5498 + 0.1 = 1.6498 (asli π²/6 ≈ 1.6449 andar hai ✓). [1.5498, 1.6498] neeche wala bound chhod deta hai. [1.6498, 1.6609] me limits ek step khisak gayi (1/10 aur 1/9). [1.4498, 1.4589] me remainder jodne ki jagah ghata diya.

questions.question: Σ (n = 2 se ∞) (ln n)/n² ke baare me kya sahi hai?
options: Diverge: ln n → ∞, to terms 1/n² se bade
Pata nahi chal sakta: 1/n² se L = ∞ aata hai
Converge: 1/n se limit comparison L = 1 deta hai
questions.explanation: ln n ≤ √n (har n ≥ 1 ke liye sach) ⇒ (ln n)/n² ≤ √n/n² = 1/n^(3/2), aur p = 3/2 > 1 ⇒ direct comparison se converge. Terms 1/n² se bade hain, par convergent series se bada hona divergence nahi deta. 1/n² ke saath L = ∞ sirf wo ek test fail karta hai, doosra comparison kaam karta hai. 1/n se L = lim (ln n)/n = 0 aata hai, 1 nahi — aur divergent 1/n ke saath L = 0 waise bhi kuch nahi batata.

questions.question: Σ (n = 2 se ∞) 1/(n (ln n)²) converge karti hai. Bound Rₙ ≤ ∫ₙ^∞ dx/(x (ln x)²) ke hisaab se error 0.1 se kam karne ke liye partial sum Sₙ me n kam se kam kitna hona chahiye?
questions.explanation: u = ln x se ∫ₙ^∞ dx/(x (ln x)²) = 1/ln n. Chahiye 1/ln n < 0.1 ⇒ ln n > 10 ⇒ n > e¹⁰ ≈ 22026.5, to n = 22027. 11 tab aata hai jab ln bhool ke 1/n < 0.1 le lo. 5 sirf wo n hai jahan ek term 0.1 se chhota hota hai — error poora tail hai, ek term nahi. 8104 ≈ e⁹ hai, exponent ek kam le liya. Moral: ln wali series converge to karti hai, par bahut dheere.

questions.question: Σ (n = 1 se ∞) (√(n + 1) − √n)/n ke baare me kya sahi hai?
questions.explanation: Rationalise karo: √(n + 1) − √n = 1/(√(n + 1) + √n) ≈ 1/(2√n). To term ≈ 1/(2√n·n) = 1/(2n^(3/2)); bₙ = 1/n^(3/2) se limit comparison L = 1/2, aur p = 3/2 > 1 ⇒ converge. (1/2)·(1/n) me denominator ka √n bhool gaye. 1/(n^(1/2)) = 1/√n me 1/2 aur /n dono chhoot gaye. 1/(n² + 1) decay ko zyada tez maan leta hai — conclusion sahi par approximation galat.

weeks.title: Alternating series and absolute convergence
weeks.summary: Is week aap alternating series test (Leibniz) lagana, absolute aur conditional convergence me fark karna, aur alternating series ke partial sum ka error aur uska sign nikalna seekhoge.
concepts: **Alternating series**: Σ (−1)ⁿ⁺¹bₙ = b₁ − b₂ + b₃ − ..., jahan bₙ > 0. Terms ka sign har baar palat-ta hai, isliye partial sums ek value ke upar-neeche jhoolte hue use ghere rehte hain — jaise damped oscillation apni final value ke around settle hota hai.

**Alternating series test (Leibniz)**: do shartein — (1) bₙ eventually decreasing ho (bₙ₊₁ ≤ bₙ), (2) bₙ → 0. Dono hon to series converge karti hai. Sirf bₙ → 0 kaafi nahi agar decreasing na ho, aur bₙ ↛ 0 ho to nth-term test se seedha divergent.

**Error bound aur sign**: AST ki shartein poori hon to |S − Sₙ| ≤ bₙ₊₁ — yaani error pehle chhode gaye term se bada nahi. Aur S − Sₙ ka sign chhode gaye pehle term ka sign hota hai: agar agla term negative hai to Sₙ true sum se zyada (overestimate) hai.

**Absolute convergence**: Σ |aₙ| converge kare to Σ aₙ **absolutely convergent** hai, aur absolute convergence ⇒ convergence (hamesha). Isliye kisi bhi sign wali series ke liye pehle Σ |aₙ| par comparison, p-series ya ratio test lagao — kaam ban gaya to baaki check ki zaroorat nahi.

**Conditional convergence**: Σ aₙ converge kare par Σ |aₙ| diverge kare. Classic example Σ (−1)ⁿ⁺¹/n = ln 2 (alternating harmonic). Σ (−1)ⁿ/nᵖ: p > 1 absolutely, 0 < p ≤ 1 conditionally, p ≤ 0 diverge (terms 0 nahi hote).

**Rearrangement ka khatra**: absolutely convergent series ke terms kisi bhi order me jodo, sum same aata hai. Conditionally convergent series ke terms ka order badalne par sum badal sakta hai (Riemann ka theorem) — isliye numerical code me aisi series ka order mat chhedo.

**Ratio test aur signs**: ratio test |aₙ₊₁/aₙ| par chalta hai, isliye L < 1 ka matlab absolute convergence hai. L = 1 aaye (jaise (−1)ⁿ/n me) to ratio test chup hai — tab AST aur Σ |aₙ| ka comparison alag-alag lagao.

example.problem: 1/e = Σ (n = 0 se ∞) (−1)ⁿ/n! hai. RC circuit ke discharge me e⁻¹ (ek time constant ke baad bacha fraction) chahiye. Kitne terms lene se error 0.001 se kam hoga, aur wo approximation kya hai?
steps: bₙ = 1/n! positive, decreasing aur → 0 hai, to AST lagta hai aur error ≤ pehla chhoda gaya term.
Error bound = 1/7! ≈ 0.000198. Chhoda gaya pehla term −1/5040 negative hai, isliye S₆ thoda zyada (overestimate) hai.
Answer: **7 terms (n = 0 se 6) se 1/e ≈ 0.3681**, error ≤ 0.0002, aur ye estimate true value se thoda upar hai.

mistakes: Sirf 'signs alternate ho rahe hain' dekh ke convergence maan lena. Σ (−1)ⁿ n/(n + 1) me terms ±1 ki taraf jaate hain, 0 nahi — ye diverge karti hai. Pehle hamesha bₙ → 0 check karo.
Error bound me bₙ₊₁ ki jagah bₙ (aakhri joda gaya term) le lena. Bound pehla CHHODA gaya term deta hai.
Conditionally convergent ko 'absolutely' bol dena kyunki series converge kar rahi hai. Absolute ke liye Σ |aₙ| alag se check karo — Σ (−1)ⁿ/√n converge karti hai par Σ 1/√n nahi.
revision: AST: bₙ decreasing aur bₙ → 0 ⇒ converge.
|S − Sₙ| ≤ bₙ₊₁, sign = pehle chhode term ka sign.
Σ |aₙ| converge ⇒ absolutely convergent ⇒ convergent.
Σ (−1)ⁿ/nᵖ: p > 1 absolute, 0 < p ≤ 1 conditional.
Conditional series ka order badla to sum badal sakta hai.

questions.question: Series Σ (n = 1 se ∞) (−1)ⁿ/√n ko classify karo.
options: Divergent, kyunki Σ 1/√n diverge karti hai
Divergent, kyunki terms 0 ki taraf nahi jaate
questions.explanation: bₙ = 1/√n decreasing aur → 0, to AST se series converge karti hai. Par Σ |aₙ| = Σ 1/√n (p = 1/2) diverge karti hai, isliye conditionally convergent. 'Σ 1/√n diverge, isliye series diverge' wala trap absolute aur ordinary convergence ko mila deta hai.

questions.question: Series Σ (n = 1 se ∞) (−1)ⁿ·n/(n + 1) ke baare me kya sahi hai?
options: Diverge karti hai, kyunki terms ka limit 0 nahi hai
Converge karti hai, kyunki ye alternating series hai
questions.explanation: |aₙ| = n/(n + 1) → 1, to aₙ → 0 nahi hota aur nth-term test se series diverge. Partial sums lagbhag −0.69 aur +0.31 ke beech jhoolte rehte hain, kisi ek value par nahi rukte. 'Alternating hai to converge' wala trap AST ki bₙ → 0 wali shart bhool jaata hai.

questions.question: S = Σ (n = 1 se ∞) (−1)ⁿ⁺¹/n³ ko S₄ = 1 − 1/8 + 1/27 − 1/64 se approximate kiya. Alternating series estimate ke hisaab se |S − S₄| ka bound kya hai?
questions.explanation: Error ≤ pehla chhoda gaya term b₅ = 1/5³ = 1/125 = 0.008. 1/64 = b₄ to S₄ me already jud chuka hai — aakhri jode gaye term ko bound maanna sabse common galti hai. 1/16 aur 1/4 me cube ki jagah square ya kuch aur le liya.

questions.question: Inme se kaunsi series conditionally convergent hai?
questions.explanation: 1/ln n decreasing aur → 0, to AST se converge. Par 1/ln n > 1/n (n ≥ 2), aur Σ 1/n diverge, to Σ 1/ln n bhi diverge ⇒ conditional. Σ (−1)ⁿ/n² aur Σ (−1)ⁿn/2ⁿ absolutely convergent hain (p = 2, aur ratio test L = 1/2). Σ (−1)ⁿ ke terms 0 nahi hote, wo diverge.

questions.question: S = Σ (n = 1 se ∞) (−1)ⁿ⁺¹/(n·2ⁿ) (iska sum ln(3/2) hai). S₃ = 1/2 − 1/8 + 1/24 ke baare me kya sahi hai?
options: S₃ ≈ 0.4167, true sum se zyada, error ≤ 1/64
S₃ ≈ 0.4167, true sum se kam, error ≤ 1/64
S₃ ≈ 0.4167, true sum se zyada, error ≤ 1/24
S₃ ≈ 0.375, true sum se kam, error ≤ 1/24
questions.explanation: S₃ = 0.5 − 0.125 + 0.04167 = 0.4167. Pehla chhoda term −1/(4·16) = −1/64 negative hai, to S₃ true sum se upar hai aur error ≤ 1/64 ≈ 0.0156. Check: ln 1.5 ≈ 0.4055, fark 0.0112 ✓. 'True sum se kam' sign ulta padhta hai; 1/24 aakhri joda gaya term hai, bound nahi; 0.375 me teesra term bhool gaye.

questions.question: Series Σ (n = 1 se ∞) (−1)ⁿ/nᵖ kin values of p ke liye conditionally convergent hai?
questions.explanation: p > 0 par 1/nᵖ decreasing aur → 0, to AST se converge. Σ 1/nᵖ sirf p > 1 par converge, to p > 1 absolute aur 0 < p ≤ 1 conditional. p ≤ 0 par terms 0 nahi hote, to diverge. 'p ≥ 1' p = 1 ko sahi pakadta hai par p = 2, 3 (jo absolute hain) ko bhi shaamil kar leta hai.

questions.question: Alternating series Σ (−1)ⁿ⁺¹bₙ (bₙ > 0) ke liye alternating series test ki shartein kya hain?
options: Sirf bₙ → 0 ho, decreasing zaroori nahi
Σ bₙ converge kare aur bₙ positive ho
bₙ eventually decreasing ho aur bₙ → 0
bₙ₊₁/bₙ → 1 ho aur bₙ bounded ho
questions.explanation: Leibniz test ki do shartein: bₙ decreasing (kuch n ke baad) aur bₙ → 0. Sirf bₙ → 0 kaafi nahi — decreasing na ho to series diverge bhi kar sakti hai. Σ bₙ converge karna absolute convergence hai: ye zyada strong shart hai, AST ki nahi, aur Σ (−1)ⁿ⁺¹/n jaisi conditional series ise poora nahi karti. Ratio → 1 se kuch pata nahi chalta.

questions.question: Kisi series ke liye Σ |aₙ| converge karti hai. Σ aₙ ke baare me kya sahi hai?
options: Σ aₙ diverge bhi kar sakti hai
Σ aₙ bhi converge karti hai
questions.explanation: Absolute convergence ⇒ convergence, hamesha — signs kuch bhi hon. 'Diverge kar sakti hai' tab lagta hai jab absolute aur ordinary convergence ka rishta ulta yaad ho (ulta implication sach nahi: Σ (−1)ⁿ/n converge karti hai par Σ 1/n nahi). Alternating hona zaroori nahi. Conditional ka matlab hai Σ |aₙ| diverge kare — yahan to wo converge kar rahi hai.

questions.question: Alternating harmonic series 1 − 1/2 + 1/3 − 1/4 + ... ka sum kya hai?
questions.explanation: Σ (−1)ⁿ⁺¹/n = ln 2 ≈ 0.693 — conditional convergence ka classic example. Ye converge karti hai, sirf Σ 1/n (bina signs) diverge karti hai, to 'diverge' galat. π²/12 alternating Σ (−1)ⁿ⁺¹/n² ka sum hai, aur 1 sirf pehla term.

questions.question: S = Σ (n = 1 se ∞) (−1)ⁿ⁺¹/n² ko Sₙ se approximate karna hai. Alternating series estimate ke hisaab se error 0.005 se kam guarantee karne ke liye kam se kam kitne terms chahiye?
questions.explanation: |S − Sₙ| ≤ bₙ₊₁ = 1/(n + 1)² < 0.005 ⇒ (n + 1)² > 200 ⇒ n + 1 ≥ 15 (14² = 196 kam hai) ⇒ n = 14. 15 tab aata hai jab aakhri JODE gaye term bₙ < 0.005 maango — bound pehla chhoda gaya term deta hai. 13 me √200 ≈ 14.1 ko neeche round kar diya (b₁₄ = 1/196 > 0.005). 200 me n² ki jagah n le liya.

questions.question: Series Σ (n = 1 se ∞) (−1)ⁿ·n²/3ⁿ ko classify karo.
questions.explanation: |aₙ₊₁/aₙ| = ((n + 1)/n)²·(1/3) → 1/3 < 1, aur ratio test |aₙ| par chalta hai, to series absolutely convergent hai. 'Conditionally' galat — L < 1 hamesha absolute convergence deta hai. L = 3 ratio ulta lene (aₙ/aₙ₊₁) se aata hai. L = 1 tab aata hai jab sirf n² ka ratio dekho aur 3ⁿ bhool jao.

questions.question: π/4 = 1 − 1/3 + 1/5 − 1/7 + ... (Leibniz series). π ≈ 4·S_N lena hai, jahan S_N pehle N terms ka sum hai. Alternating series estimate ke hisaab se π me error 0.001 se kam karne ke liye kam se kam kitne terms N chahiye?
questions.explanation: N terms ke baad pehla chhoda term 1/(2N + 1) hai, to |π/4 − S_N| ≤ 1/(2N + 1) aur π ka error ≤ 4/(2N + 1). Chahiye 4/(2N + 1) < 0.001 ⇒ 2N + 1 > 4000 ⇒ N ≥ 2000. 500 tab aata hai jab π/4 ka error 0.001 se kam karo aur 4 se multiply karna bhool jao. 4001 me term ko 1/N maan liya (odd denominators bhool gaye). 1999 par 2N + 1 = 3999, to bound 4/3999 abhi bhi 0.001 se thoda bada hai.

questions.question: 1 − 1/e = Σ (n = 1 se ∞) (−1)ⁿ⁺¹/n! hai, yaani 1 − 1/2! + 1/3! − ... S₄ = 1 − 1/2 + 1/6 − 1/24 ke baare me kya sahi hai?
options: S₄ = 0.625, true sum se kam, error ≤ 1/120
S₄ = 0.625, true sum se zyada, error ≤ 1/120
S₄ = 0.625, true sum se kam, error ≤ 1/24
S₄ ≈ 0.667, true sum se zyada, error ≤ 1/24
questions.explanation: S₄ = 1 − 0.5 + 0.16667 − 0.04167 = 0.625. bₙ = 1/n! decreasing aur → 0, to error ≤ pehla chhoda term b₅ = 1/120 ≈ 0.0083. Wo term +1/120 (positive) hai, to S₄ true sum se kam (underestimate) hai. Check: 1 − 1/e ≈ 0.6321, fark 0.0071 ✓. 'Zyada' sign ulta padhta hai. 1/24 aakhri joda gaya term hai, bound nahi. 0.667 to S₃ hai.

questions.question: Series Σ (n = 1 se ∞) (−1)ⁿ·n/(n² + 1) ko classify karo.
options: Divergent, kyunki Σ n/(n² + 1) diverge hai
Divergent, kyunki bₙ decreasing nahi hai
questions.explanation: bₙ = n/(n² + 1): f(x) = x/(x² + 1) ka f' = (1 − x²)/(x² + 1)² ≤ 0 (x ≥ 1), to decreasing, aur bₙ → 0 ⇒ AST se converge. Absolute: n/(n² + 1) ko 1/n se limit-compare karo, L = 1, aur Σ 1/n diverge ⇒ Σ |aₙ| diverge. To conditionally convergent. 'Σ n/(n² + 1) diverge isliye series diverge' absolute aur ordinary convergence ko mila deta hai. bₙ n = 1 se hi decreasing hai (1/2, 2/5, 3/10, ...).

questions.question: 1 − 1/2 + 1/3 − 1/4 + ... = ln 2 hai. Inhi terms ko is order me likha: 1 − 1/2 − 1/4 + 1/3 − 1/6 − 1/8 + 1/5 − 1/10 − 1/12 + ... (ek positive, phir do negative). Is rearranged series ka sum kya hai?
questions.explanation: Teen-teen ke group lo: 1/(2k − 1) − 1/(4k − 2) − 1/(4k) = 1/(4k − 2) − 1/(4k) = (1/2)[1/(2k − 1) − 1/(2k)]. Bracket wala hissa original alternating harmonic series ka k-th pair hai, to sum = (1/2) ln 2 ≈ 0.347. 'ln 2' maanna conditionally convergent series me order badalne ka trap hai — Riemann ke theorem se sum badal sakta hai. 2 ln 2 me 1/2 ulta lag gaya. Terms 0 ki taraf jaate hain aur partial sums settle hote hain, to diverge nahi.

weeks.title: Power series, Taylor series and approximation error
weeks.summary: Is week aap power series ka radius aur poora interval of convergence (endpoints samet) nikaloge, standard Maclaurin series yaad karke unse nayi series banaoge, aur Taylor approximation ka error Lagrange remainder ya alternating bound se estimate karoge.
concepts: **Interval of convergence**: Σ cₙ(x − a)ⁿ ke liye ratio test se radius R nikaalo: |x − a| < R par absolutely converge, |x − a| > R par diverge. Endpoints x = a ± R par ratio test L = 1 deta hai, isliye wahan series ko alag se (p-series, AST, comparison se) check karna padta hai — interval (a − R, a + R), [ ], [ ) ya ( ] kuch bhi ho sakta hai.

**Term-by-term calculus**: R ke andar power series ko term-by-term differentiate ya integrate kar sakte ho, aur radius same rehta hai (endpoints badal sakte hain). Jaise 1/(1 − x) = Σ xⁿ ko integrate karke −ln(1 − x) = Σ xⁿ⁺¹/(n + 1), aur differentiate karke 1/(1 − x)² = Σ n xⁿ⁻¹.

**Taylor series**: f(x) = Σ f⁽ⁿ⁾(a)(x − a)ⁿ/n!. a = 0 par isse **Maclaurin series** kehte hain. Coefficient cₙ = f⁽ⁿ⁾(a)/n!, isliye ulta bhi kaam aata hai: series pata ho to f⁽ⁿ⁾(a) = n!·cₙ, bina baar-baar differentiate kiye.

**Standard Maclaurin series**: sin x = x − x³/3! + x⁵/5! − ... aur cos x = 1 − x²/2! + x⁴/4! − ... (har x); ln(1 + x) = x − x²/2 + x³/3 − ... (−1 < x ≤ 1); tan⁻¹ x = x − x³/3 + x⁵/5 − ... (|x| ≤ 1); binomial (1 + x)ᵏ = 1 + kx + k(k − 1)x²/2! + ... (|x| < 1). Nayi series substitution se banao: e^(−x²) me eˣ ki series me x → −x² rakh do.

**Lagrange remainder**: degree n Taylor polynomial Pₙ ka error Rₙ(x) = f⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁾(c)(x − a)ⁿ⁺¹/(n + 1)!, kisi c ke liye jo a aur x ke beech hai. Agar |f⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁾| ≤ M us interval par, to |Rₙ| ≤ M|x − a|ⁿ⁺¹/(n + 1)!. Series alternating ho (sin, cos, ln(1 + x) chhote x par) to aasaan bound: pehla chhoda gaya term.

**Engineering approximations**: chhote angle par sin θ ≈ θ aur cos θ ≈ 1 − θ²/2 (pendulum, aircraft ka small pitch angle). Binomial se altitude h par gravity g(h) = g₀(1 + h/R)⁻² ≈ g₀(1 − 2h/R) jab h ≪ R. Ye linearisation hi control systems me non-linear equations ko linear banata hai.

**Kitna accurate?**: approximation ka relative error dekho. sin θ ≈ θ me agla term θ³/6 hai, to θ = 0.1 rad (≈ 5.7°) par error ≤ 0.000167, yaani 0.17% se kam. θ = 0.5 rad par wahi bound 0.0208 ho jaata hai (lagbhag 4%) — 'small angle' ka matlab ye numbers decide karte hain.

example.problem: Power series Σ (n = 1 se ∞) (x − 2)ⁿ/(n·3ⁿ) ka radius aur interval of convergence nikalo.
steps: Ratio test: |aₙ₊₁/aₙ| = |x − 2|·n/(3(n + 1)) → |x − 2|/3.
|x − 2|/3 < 1 ⇒ |x − 2| < 3 ⇒ R = 3, aur open interval −1 < x < 5.
Endpoint x = 5: terms 3ⁿ/(n·3ⁿ) = 1/n, harmonic series ⇒ diverge.
Endpoint x = −1: terms (−3)ⁿ/(n·3ⁿ) = (−1)ⁿ/n, alternating harmonic ⇒ (conditionally) converge.
Answer: **R = 3, interval of convergence [−1, 5)** — left endpoint shaamil, right endpoint nahi.

mistakes: Ratio test se R nikaal ke endpoints check kiye bina open interval likh dena. Endpoints par L = 1 hota hai, to wahan answer ratio test se kabhi nahi milta — alag test lagao.
Taylor coefficient me n! bhool jaana: cₙ = f⁽ⁿ⁾(a)/n!, sirf f⁽ⁿ⁾(a) nahi. e^(2x) me x³ ka coefficient 2³/3! = 4/3 hai, 8 nahi.
Series ko uske interval ke bahar use karna: ln(1 + x) ki series x = 2 par diverge karti hai, chahe ln 3 exist karta ho. Pehle |x| < R check karo.
revision: R ratio test se; endpoints alag se check.
cₙ = f⁽ⁿ⁾(a)/n!.
sin, cos, eˣ: har x par; ln(1 + x): (−1, 1]; 1/(1 − x), (1 + x)ᵏ: |x| < 1.
Alternating series me error ≤ pehla chhoda term.
(1 + x)ᵏ ≈ 1 + kx jab |x| ≪ 1.

questions.question: cos x ki Maclaurin series ke pehle teen non-zero terms kya hain?
questions.explanation: cos x = 1 − x²/2! + x⁴/4! − ... = 1 − x²/2 + x⁴/24. x − x³/6 + x⁵/120 sin x ki series hai. Saare plus signs cosh x ke hain. x⁴/4 me 4! ki jagah 4 le liya.

questions.question: Power series Σ (n = 1 se ∞) n·xⁿ/4ⁿ ka radius of convergence kya hai?
questions.explanation: |aₙ₊₁/aₙ| = (n + 1)|x|/(4n) → |x|/4 < 1 ⇒ |x| < 4, to R = 4. Factor n ratio me 1 ki taraf jaata hai, radius ko nahi badalta. 1/4 tab aata hai jab |x|/4 < 1 ko |x| < 1/4 padh lo.

questions.question: Σ (n = 1 se ∞) (x + 1)ⁿ/n² ka interval of convergence kya hai?
questions.explanation: Ratio test se |x + 1| < 1, yaani −2 < x < 0, R = 1. x = 0 par Σ 1/n² (p = 2) converge; x = −2 par Σ (−1)ⁿ/n² absolutely converge. Dono endpoints shaamil ⇒ [−2, 0]. (−2, 0) endpoints check nahi karta; [−2, 0) n² ko n samajh leta hai; (0, 2] center ko −1 ki jagah +1 le leta hai.

questions.question: e^(2x) ki Maclaurin series me x³ ka coefficient kya hai?
questions.explanation: eᵘ = Σ uⁿ/n! me u = 2x rakho: x³ wala term (2x)³/3! = 8x³/6, to coefficient 8/6 = 4/3. 8 me 3! bhool gaye; 1/6 me 2³ bhool gaye (eˣ ka coefficient); 2/3 me 2³ ki jagah 2·2 liya.

questions.question: Altitude h par gravity g(h) = g₀(1 + h/R)⁻² hai, R = 6400 km. Space station h = 400 km par hai. Binomial (linear) approximation se g(h)/g₀ kitna aata hai?
questions.explanation: (1 + u)⁻² ≈ 1 − 2u, u = h/R = 400/6400 = 0.0625, to g/g₀ ≈ 1 − 0.125 = 0.875. 0.9375 = 1 − u me exponent −2 ka factor 2 bhool gaye. 0.8858 exact value (1/1.0625)² hai — wo approximation nahi; linear approx ka error yahan lagbhag 1% hai kyunki u bahut chhota nahi.

questions.question: ln(1.2) ko ln(1 + x) ke degree 3 Maclaurin polynomial x − x²/2 + x³/3 se (x = 0.2) approximate karo. Approximation aur uska error bound kya hai?
questions.explanation: 0.2 − 0.02 + 0.008/3 = 0.2 − 0.02 + 0.00267 = 0.1827. x = 0.2 par series alternating aur decreasing hai, to error ≤ agla term x⁴/4 = 0.0016/4 = 0.0004 (actual ln 1.2 = 0.18232, error ≈ 0.00035 ✓). 0.0016 me x⁴ ko 4 se divide karna bhool gaye. 0.1800 sirf degree 2 hai. 0.2227 me saare signs plus le liye.

questions.question: sin x ki Maclaurin series me x³ ka coefficient kya hai?
questions.explanation: sin x = x − x³/3! + x⁵/5! − ..., to x³ ka coefficient −1/3! = −1/6. 1/6 me sign bhool gaye (series me signs alternate karte hain). ±1/3 me 3! ki jagah sirf 3 le liya.

questions.question: Power series Σ (n = 0 se ∞) xⁿ/n! ka radius of convergence kya hai?
questions.explanation: |aₙ₊₁/aₙ| = |x|/(n + 1) → 0 < 1 har x ke liye, to R = ∞ (ye eˣ ki series hai, jo har x par converge karti hai). R = 1 geometric series wala reflex hai. 0 ulta hai — wo Σ n!xⁿ ka radius hai. e to x = 1 par sum ki value hai, radius nahi.

questions.question: f(x) ki Maclaurin series 2 + 3x − 5x² + 7x³ + ... hai. f''(0) kya hai?
questions.explanation: cₙ = f⁽ⁿ⁾(0)/n! ⇒ f''(0) = 2!·c₂ = 2 × (−5) = −10. −5 sirf coefficient hai (n! se multiply bhool gaye). −5/2 me 2! se multiply ki jagah divide kar diya. 10 me sign chhoot gaya.

questions.question: e^(−x²) ki Maclaurin series me x⁶ ka coefficient kya hai?
questions.explanation: eᵘ = Σ uⁿ/n! me u = −x²: x⁶ wala term (−x²)³/3! = −x⁶/6, to coefficient −1/6. −1/720 me 6! le liya — par x⁶ yahan n = 3 se aata hai, n = 6 se nahi. 1/6 me (−1)³ ka sign bhool gaye. 1/24 x⁸ wale term (n = 4) ka coefficient hai.

questions.question: Σ (n = 0 se ∞) (2x − 1)ⁿ/3ⁿ ka interval of convergence kya hai?
questions.explanation: Ye geometric series hai, ratio (2x − 1)/3. Converge ⇔ |2x − 1| < 3 ⇔ −1 < x < 2. Endpoints: x = 2 par ratio 1 (Σ 1 diverge), x = −1 par ratio −1 (Σ (−1)ⁿ diverge, terms 0 nahi hote). To (−1, 2), dono endpoints bahar. (−2, 4) tab aata hai jab 2x ka factor 2 bhool ke |x − 1| < 3 le lo. Bracket wale options endpoints bina check kiye shaamil kar lete hain.

questions.question: e^0.5 ko degree 3 Maclaurin polynomial P₃(x) = 1 + x + x²/2 + x³/6 se approximate karo. Lagrange remainder me M = 2 lo (kyunki 0 ≤ c ≤ 0.5 par e^c < 2). Approximation aur error bound kya hai?
questions.explanation: P₃(0.5) = 1 + 0.5 + 0.125 + 0.02083 = 1.6458. |R₃| ≤ M·(0.5)⁴/4! = 2 × 0.0625/24 ≈ 0.0052 (asli e^0.5 = 1.64872, error ≈ 0.0029 ✓). 0.0026 me M = 1 le liya — ye bound galat hai, kyunki asli error 0.0029 usse bada hai. 1.6250 sirf degree 2 polynomial hai. 0.0208 aakhri joda gaya term x³/6 hai, remainder nahi.

questions.question: sin(0.5) ko sin x ki Maclaurin series se nikalna hai. Series alternating hai, to error ≤ pehla chhoda gaya term. Error 10⁻⁶ se kam guarantee karne ke liye kam se kam kitne non-zero terms chahiye?
questions.explanation: x = 0.5 par terms: x⁵/120 ≈ 0.00026, x⁷/5040 ≈ 1.55 × 10⁻⁶, x⁹/362880 ≈ 5.4 × 10⁻⁹. 3 terms (x⁵ tak) par pehla chhoda term 1.55 × 10⁻⁶ hai, jo 10⁻⁶ se zyada — thoda kam pad jaata hai. 4 terms (x⁷ tak) par chhoda term 5.4 × 10⁻⁹ ✓. 5 terms zaroorat se zyada hain. 2 terms par error ~0.00026 rehta hai.

questions.question: 1/(1 − x) = Σ xⁿ ko differentiate karke aur x se multiply karke Σ n·xⁿ ka closed form nikalo. Iski madad se Σ (n = 1 se ∞) n/2ⁿ ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: Differentiate: 1/(1 − x)² = Σ n xⁿ⁻¹. x se multiply: Σ n xⁿ = x/(1 − x)² (|x| < 1). x = 1/2 rakho: (1/2)/(1/4) = 2. 4 tab aata hai jab x se multiply karna bhool jao (1/(1 − x)² = 4). 1 = Σ 1/2ⁿ hai (n ke bina, sirf geometric). 1/2 sirf pehla term hai.

questions.question: f(x) = x²·eˣ hai. Maclaurin series ki madad se (baar-baar differentiate kiye bina) f⁽⁵⁾(0) nikalo.
questions.explanation: x²eˣ = x²(1 + x + x²/2! + x³/3! + ...), to x⁵ ka coefficient c₅ = 1/3! = 1/6. f⁽⁵⁾(0) = 5!·c₅ = 120/6 = 20. 1/6 sirf coefficient hai (5! se multiply bhool gaye). 120 me c₅ = 1 maan liya. 60 me galti se c₅ = 1/2! le liya (wo x⁴ ka coefficient hai).

weeks.title: First-order ODEs: separable, exact and Bernoulli equations
weeks.summary: Is week aap first-order ODEs ke chaar bade types solve karoge — separable, exact, integrating factor se exact banaye gaye equations, aur Bernoulli — aur pehchaanna seekhoge ki kaunsa method kis equation par lagta hai.
concepts: **Separable equation**: dy/dx = g(x)·h(y). y wale terms ek taraf, x wale doosri taraf: ∫ dy/h(y) = ∫ g(x) dx + C. Answer aksar implicit hota hai (y akela nahi nikalta), aur constant C ek hi baar, integrate karne ke turant baad lagao.

**Khoye hue solutions**: h(y) se divide karte waqt maan liya ki h(y) ≠ 0. Jin y₀ par h(y₀) = 0 hai, y = y₀ (constant) bhi solution hai — jaise dy/dx = xy me y = 0. Initial condition y(0) = 0 ho to yahi sahi answer hai, formula wala nahi.

**Exact equation**: M(x, y) dx + N(x, y) dy = 0 exact hai agar ∂M/∂y = ∂N/∂x. Tab ek function F(x, y) hai jiska F_x = M aur F_y = N, aur solution F(x, y) = C. F nikalne ke liye M ko x me integrate karo, phir y ka bacha hua function g(y) N se match karke nikaalo.

**Integrating factor (non-exact ke liye)**: agar (M_y − N_x)/N sirf x ka function ho, to μ(x) = e^(∫(M_y − N_x)/N dx). Agar (N_x − M_y)/M sirf y ka function ho, to μ(y) = e^(∫(N_x − M_y)/M dy). μ se poori equation multiply karo, wo exact ban jaati hai. First-order linear ka e^(∫P dx) isi idea ka special case hai.

**Bernoulli equation**: y' + P(x)y = Q(x)yⁿ (n ≠ 0, 1). Non-linear hai, par substitution v = y¹⁻ⁿ use linear bana deta hai: v' + (1 − n)P v = (1 − n)Q. Phir linear wala integrating factor lagao aur aakhir me y = v^(1/(1 − n)) wapas likho.

**Method pehchaano**: (1) kya f(x)g(y) me tootta hai? separable. (2) kya y' + Py = Q hai? linear. (3) yⁿ extra hai? Bernoulli. (4) M dx + N dy form me M_y = N_x? exact; warna integrating factor try karo. Kai equations ek se zyada tareeke se solve hoti hain — sabse chhota raasta chuno.

**Existence aur uniqueness**: y' = f(x, y), y(x₀) = y₀ me agar f aur ∂f/∂y point ke aas-paas continuous hain, to ek hi solution hota hai. dy/dx = 3y^(2/3), y(0) = 0 me ∂f/∂y = 2y^(−1/3) zero par blow up karta hai — aur sach me y = 0 aur y = x³ dono solutions hain.

example.problem: (2xy + 3) dx + (x² + 4y) dy = 0 ko y(1) = 1 ke saath solve karo.
steps: M = 2xy + 3, N = x² + 4y. M_y = 2x aur N_x = 2x — barabar, to equation **exact** hai.
F_x = M ⇒ F = ∫ (2xy + 3) dx = x²y + 3x + g(y).
F_y = x² + g'(y) ko N = x² + 4y ke barabar rakho ⇒ g'(y) = 4y ⇒ g(y) = 2y².
To F(x, y) = x²y + 3x + 2y², aur general solution x²y + 3x + 2y² = C.
Check: F_x = 2xy + 3 = M ✓, F_y = x² + 4y = N ✓.
Answer: **x²y + 3x + 2y² = 6** (implicit solution).

mistakes: Exact equation me F = ∫M dx + ∫N dy likh dena. Isse common terms (jaise x²y) do baar aa jaate hain. Sahi tareeka: ∫M dx lo, phir sirf g(y) N se nikaalo.
Bernoulli me substitution v = yⁿ ya v = y¹⁻ⁿ ka exponent galat lena. n = 3 ho to v = y⁻², aur v' = −2y⁻³y'. Aakhir me y par wapas jaana mat bhoolo.
Separable equation me C ko baad me exponent ke bahar galat jagah lagana: ln|y| = x²/2 + C ⇒ y = A·e^(x²/2), y = e^(x²/2) + C nahi.
revision: Separable: ∫ dy/h(y) = ∫ g(x) dx.
Exact: M_y = N_x ⇒ F(x, y) = C.
(M_y − N_x)/N sirf x ka ⇒ μ(x) = e^∫.
Bernoulli yⁿ: v = y¹⁻ⁿ se linear.
h(y₀) = 0 wale constant solutions check karo.

questions.question: dy/dx = x·y, y(0) = 2 ka solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: Separate karo: dy/y = x dx ⇒ ln|y| = x²/2 + C ⇒ y = A·e^(x²/2). y(0) = 2 ⇒ A = 2. 'e^(x²/2) + 1' me C ko exponent ke bahar plus kar diya — wo initial condition to satisfy karta hai par ODE nahi. 2eˣ me x ka integral x²/2 ki jagah x le liya.

questions.question: Inme se kaunsi equation exact hai?
questions.explanation: 2xy dx + x² dy: M_y = 2x, N_x = 2x, barabar ⇒ exact (F = x²y). y dx − x dy me M_y = 1, N_x = −1. x dx − xy dy me M_y = 0, N_x = −y. (x + y) dx + (y − x) dy me M_y = 1, N_x = −1. Sign par dhyan na dene se pehla aur aakhri option exact lagte hain.

questions.question: Bernoulli equation y' + y = x·y³ ko linear banane ke liye kaunsa substitution lagega?
questions.explanation: n = 3, to v = y¹⁻ⁿ = y⁻². Isse v' = −2y⁻³y', aur equation ko −2y⁻³ se multiply karke v' − 2v = −2x milta hai — linear. v = y⁻³ me exponent −n le liya, 1 − n nahi. v = y³ ya y² se equation linear nahi banti.

questions.question: (3xy + y²) dx + (x² + xy) dy = 0 exact nahi hai. Kaunsa integrating factor ise exact banayega?
questions.explanation: M_y = 3x + 2y, N_x = 2x + y. (M_y − N_x)/N = (x + y)/(x(x + y)) = 1/x, sirf x ka ⇒ μ = e^(∫dx/x) = x. Check: x se multiply karke M = 3x²y + xy², N = x³ + x²y, aur M_y = 3x² + 2xy = N_x ✓. 1/x tab aata hai jab exponent ka integral lena bhool ke (M_y − N_x)/N ko hi μ maan lo.

questions.question: dy/dt = −2t·y², y(0) = 1 hai. y(2) kya hai?
questions.explanation: dy/y² = −2t dt ⇒ −1/y = −t² + C. y(0) = 1 ⇒ C = −1, to 1/y = t² + 1 ⇒ y = 1/(1 + t²), y(2) = 1/5. e⁻⁴ tab aata hai jab y² ko y samajh ke linear decay ki tarah solve karo. 1/3 me C ka sign galat ho gaya (1/y = t² − 1).

questions.question: Bernoulli equation y' + y/x = x·y², y(1) = 1 (x > 0) solve karo. y(1.5) kya hai?
questions.explanation: v = 1/y lo: v' − v/x = −x. Integrating factor 1/x: (v/x)' = −1 ⇒ v/x = −x + C ⇒ v = Cx − x². v(1) = 1 ⇒ C = 2, to y = 1/(2x − x²). x = 1.5 par 2x − x² = 3 − 2.25 = 0.75 ⇒ y = 4/3. 3/4 to v ki value hai — y = 1/v karna bhool gaye. −4/3 v' wali equation me sign ulta lene se (v = x² − 2x) aata hai.

questions.question: dy/dx = e^(x + y) ko solve karne ka sabse seedha tareeka kya hai?
questions.explanation: e^(x + y) = eˣ·eʸ, jo f(x)g(y) me tootta hai, to separable: e^(−y) dy = eˣ dx ⇒ −e^(−y) = eˣ + C. Equation y' + Py = Q jaisi linear nahi (eʸ hai), aur yⁿ wala Bernoulli structure bhi nahi. Exact form me likh sakte ho, par method recipe me pehla check separable hi hai — sabse chhota raasta.

questions.question: dy/dx = y², y(0) = 1 ka solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: Separate: dy/y² = dx ⇒ −1/y = x + C. y(0) = 1 ⇒ C = −1 ⇒ y = 1/(1 − x) (x < 1 tak). y = eˣ to y' = y ka solution hai, y² ka nahi. 1/(1 + x) me sign galat hai (wo y' = −y² ka solution hai). 1 + x³/3 me y² ko x² samajh ke seedha integrate kar diya.

questions.question: dy/dx = x(y − 2) ko separate karke divide karne par kaunsa constant solution chhoot jaata hai?
questions.explanation: Separate karte waqt (y − 2) se divide kiya, jo y = 2 par zero hai. y = 2 rakho: LHS 0, RHS x·0 = 0 ✓, to y = 2 bhi solution hai. y = 0 tab hota jab equation x·y hoti (yahan y = 0 par RHS −2x ≠ 0). y = −2 sign ka confusion hai. 'Koi nahi' galat — jin y par h(y) = 0 ho, unhe hamesha check karo.

questions.question: (2x + y) dx + (x + 2y) dy = 0 ka general solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: M_y = 1 = N_x, to exact. F = ∫ (2x + y) dx = x² + xy + g(y); F_y = x + g'(y) = x + 2y ⇒ g = y². To x² + xy + y² = C. x² + 2xy + y² me xy do baar gin liya (∫M dx + ∫N dy wala trap). x² + y² me cross term xy chhoot gaya. 2x² + xy + 2y² me integrate karte waqt power se divide karna bhool gaye.

questions.question: y' + (2/x)y = x, y(1) = 1 (x > 0) hai. y(2) kya hai?
questions.explanation: Integrating factor μ = e^(∫2/x dx) = x². (x²y)' = x³ ⇒ x²y = x⁴/4 + C ⇒ y = x²/4 + C/x². y(1) = 1 ⇒ 1/4 + C = 1 ⇒ C = 3/4, to y(2) = 1 + 3/16 = 19/16. μ = x lene se (xy)' = x² galti se likhte hain aur 5/3 aata hai. 5/4 me C = 1 le liya (1/4 ghatana bhool gaye). 1 tab jab y ko constant samajh lo.

questions.question: y dx + (2x + 3y²) dy = 0 exact nahi hai. Sahi integrating factor aur solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: M_y = 1, N_x = 2. (N_x − M_y)/M = 1/y sirf y ka function hai ⇒ μ = e^(∫dy/y) = y. Multiply: y² dx + (2xy + 3y³) dy, ab M_y = 2y = N_x ✓. F = xy² + g(y), F_y = 2xy + g' ⇒ g' = 3y³ ⇒ g = (3/4)y⁴. 'xy² + y³' me 3y³ ka integral galat hai (power 4 aani chahiye). μ = x se M_y = x aur N_x = 4x + 3y² — exact nahi. μ = y² se M_y = 3y² aur N_x = 2y² — ye bhi exact nahi.

questions.question: y' = y − y², y(0) = 1/2 ko Bernoulli substitution v = 1/y se solve karo. y(ln 3) kya hai?
questions.explanation: n = 2, v = y⁻¹ ⇒ v' = −y'/y² = −1/y + 1 = −v + 1. Linear: v = 1 + Ce^(−x), v(0) = 1/y(0) = 2 ⇒ C = 1. x = ln 3 par v = 1 + 1/3 = 4/3, to y = 1/v = 3/4. 4/3 khud v hai — y par wapas jaana bhool gaye. 1/4 tab aata hai jab v = 1 + Ceˣ (sign galat) lo: v = 4. 6/5 me v(0) = 1/2 le liya, yaani y(0) ko hi v(0) samajh liya.

questions.question: dy/dx = √y, y(0) = 0 (x ≥ 0) ke solutions ke baare me kya sahi hai?
options: Do solutions: y = 0 aur y = x²/4
questions.explanation: Separate: dy/√y = dx ⇒ 2√y = x + C, y(0) = 0 ⇒ C = 0 ⇒ y = x²/4 (check: y' = x/2 = √y ✓). Par √y se divide karte waqt y = 0 chhoot gaya, aur y = 0 bhi equation aur IC dono satisfy karta hai. Uniqueness theorem yahan lagu nahi hota, kyunki ∂f/∂y = 1/(2√y) y = 0 par blow up karta hai — isliye ek hi solution hona zaroori nahi. Theorem fail hone ka matlab 'koi solution nahi' nahi hota.

questions.question: dy/dx = x/y, y(0) = −2 hai. y(√5) kya hai?
questions.explanation: y dy = x dx ⇒ y²/2 = x²/2 + C ⇒ y² = x² + 4 (y(0) = −2 se). Initial value negative hai, to wahi branch chuno: y = −√(x² + 4), aur y(√5) = −√9 = −3. +3 doosri branch hai jo IC satisfy nahi karti. '±3' dono branches ko solution maan leta hai, par IVP ka ek hi continuous solution hai. −√14 tab aata hai jab x²/2 ka 1/2 bhool ke y² = 2x² + 4 likh do.

weeks.title: Modelling with first-order ODEs
weeks.summary: Is week aap real systems ko first-order ODE me badalna seekhoge — exponential growth/decay, mixing tank, Newton's law of cooling, RL circuit, aur linear aur quadratic drag ke saath girti cheez ki terminal velocity.
concepts: **Modelling recipe**: (1) unknown quantity aur uski unit chuno, (2) 'rate of change = rate in − rate out' likho, (3) initial condition daalo, (4) solve karo, (5) units aur long-time behaviour se answer check karo. Zyaadatar engineering models ka shape y' = −k(y − y∞) hota hai, jiska solution y = y∞ + (y₀ − y∞)e^(−kt).

**Exponential growth/decay**: y' = ky ⇒ y = y₀e^(kt). Decay (k < 0) me **half-life** t½ = ln 2/|k|, aur time constant τ = 1/|k| (ek τ me value e⁻¹ ≈ 36.8% reh jaati hai). Radioactive isotopes, capacitor discharge, battery self-discharge sab isi model me aate hain.

**Mixing problems**: tank me Q(t) amount of salt/contaminant. Rate in = (inflow concentration)×(inflow rate); rate out = (Q/V)×(outflow rate), kyunki well-mixed tank me concentration Q/V hai. Inflow aur outflow barabar ho to V constant rehta hai aur equation linear first-order banti hai.

**Newton's law of cooling**: dT/dt = −k(T − Tₐ), jahan Tₐ ambient temperature hai. Solution T = Tₐ + (T₀ − Tₐ)e^(−kt). Avionics box, brake disc ya engine ke parts ki cooling isi se estimate hoti hai — k do measurements se nikaalte hain.

**RL aur RC circuits**: series RL ko DC source V se jodo to L di/dt + Ri = V ⇒ i = (V/R)(1 − e^(−t/τ)), τ = L/R. Ek τ par current final value ka 63.2% hota hai. Yahi structure RC me τ = RC ke saath aata hai — maths same, sirf variables badle.

**Linear drag (dheemi speed)**: m dv/dt = mg − bv. Terminal velocity v_t = mg/b (jab dv/dt = 0), aur v = v_t(1 − e^(−t/τ)) jahan τ = m/b. Ye model chhote particles ya bahut dheemi speed par theek hai.

**Quadratic drag (tez speed)**: hawa me zyaadatar cheezon par drag ≈ cv², to m dv/dt = mg − cv². Terminal velocity v_t = √(mg/c), aur separable solve karke v(t) = v_t·tanh(gt/v_t). Parachute aur skydiver ki speed isi se design hoti hai — c badhao (bada canopy) to v_t ghatega.

**Equilibrium se sanity check**: kisi bhi model me y' = 0 rakhke steady state nikaalo — final temperature = Tₐ, final salt = inflow concentration × V, final current = V/R, final speed = v_t. Agar tumhara solution t → ∞ par is value par nahi jaata, to kahin sign ya constant galat hai.

example.problem: Ek avionics box 90°C par hai aur cabin 30°C par. 10 minute baad box 70°C par hai. Newton's law of cooling se: box 40°C par kab aayega?
steps: Isse k = ln(3/2)/10 ≈ 0.04055 per minute.
Sanity check: pehle 10 min me 20°C gira, par agle 34 min me sirf 30°C — difference T − Tₐ chhota hone par cooling dheemi ho jaati hai ✓.
Answer: lagbhag **44.2 minute** par box 40°C tak thanda hoga.

mistakes: Newton's cooling me ambient bhool ke T = T₀e^(−kt) likh dena. Isse temperature 0°C ki taraf jaata dikhega, cabin temperature ki taraf nahi. Hamesha (T − Tₐ) decay hota hai.
Mixing problem me outflow concentration ko inflow concentration maan lena. Bahar jaane wale liquid ka concentration tank ka current concentration Q/V hai.
Quadratic drag me linear wala formula lagana: v_t = mg/c nahi, √(mg/c) hai, aur v(t) exponential nahi balki tanh hai.
revision: Half-life t½ = ln 2/k; time constant τ = 1/k.
Mixing: rate out = (Q/V)·outflow rate.
RL: τ = L/R; RC: τ = RC.
Linear drag v_t = mg/b; quadratic drag v_t = √(mg/c), v = v_t tanh(gt/v_t).

questions.question: Ek battery ka charge Q' = −0.1·Q (t hours me) se self-discharge hota hai. Half-life kitni hai?
questions.explanation: Q = Q₀e^(−0.1t). Aadha hone par e^(−0.1t) = 1/2 ⇒ t = ln 2/0.1 ≈ 6.93 h. 10 h to time constant τ = 1/k hai (jab 36.8% bachta hai, 50% nahi). 0.069 h me ln 2 ko 0.1 se multiply kar diya, divide nahi.

questions.question: 2 kg ka sensor pod linear drag ke saath girta hai: m dv/dt = mg − bv, b = 0.5 N·s/m, g = 9.8 m/s². Terminal velocity kya hai?
questions.explanation: Terminal par dv/dt = 0 ⇒ mg = bv ⇒ v_t = mg/b = 2 × 9.8/0.5 = 39.2 m/s. 2.45 m/s me fraction ulta (bg/m) le liya. 19.6 to weight mg (newton me) hai, b se divide karna bhool gaye.

questions.question: 100 L ke tank me shuru me saaf paani hai. 2 g/L wala brine 5 L/min se andar aata hai, aur well-mixed solution 5 L/min se bahar jaata hai. 20 minute baad tank me kitna salt hai?
Ek power resistor 100°C par hai aur hawa 20°C par. Cooling constant k = 0.05 per min hai. 20 minute baad resistor ka temperature kya hoga?
questions.explanation: T = 20 + 80e^(−0.05t). t = 20 par e⁻¹ ≈ 0.3679, to T ≈ 20 + 29.4 = 49.4 °C. 29.4 °C me ambient 20 jodna bhool gaye. 36.8 °C = 100e⁻¹ ambient ko poori tarah ignore karta hai (T = T₀e^(−kt)).

questions.question: Series RL circuit: L = 0.5 H, R = 10 Ω, aur t = 0 par 12 V DC source joda gaya (i(0) = 0). t = 0.05 s par current kitna hai?
questions.explanation: τ = L/R = 0.5/10 = 0.05 s, final current V/R = 1.2 A. i(τ) = 1.2(1 − e⁻¹) ≈ 1.2 × 0.632 = 0.76 A. 1.2 A steady-state hai, jo sirf kai τ baad aata hai. 0.44 A = 1.2e⁻¹ decay wala formula hai, charging wala nahi.

questions.question: 80 kg ka skydiver quadratic drag ke saath girta hai: m dv/dt = mg − cv², c = 0.25 kg/m, g = 9.8 m/s², v(0) = 0. Terminal velocity ka aadha (v_t/2) kitne second me pahunchega?
questions.explanation: v_t = √(mg/c) = √(80 × 9.8/0.25) = √3136 = 56 m/s. v = v_t·tanh(gt/v_t) = 28 ⇒ tanh(gt/56) = 0.5 ⇒ gt/56 = tanh⁻¹(0.5) ≈ 0.5493 ⇒ t ≈ 0.5493 × 56/9.8 ≈ 3.14 s. 2.86 s = 28/9.8 drag ignore karke free fall hai. 3.96 s linear-drag wala ln 2·(v_t/g) hai — galat model. 5.71 s = v_t/g.

questions.question: Ek RC circuit me R = 10 kΩ aur C = 100 μF hai. Time constant τ kya hai?
questions.explanation: τ = RC = (10 × 10³ Ω)(100 × 10⁻⁶ F) = 1 s. 1000 s tab aata hai jab dono prefixes bhool ke 10 × 100 kar do. 0.001 s me k (10³) bhool gaye. 10⁶ s me μ (10⁻⁶) bhool gaye. Prefixes ko powers of 10 me badal ke hi multiply karo.

questions.question: 200 L ke tank me 3 g/L wala brine 4 L/min se aata hai aur well-mixed solution 4 L/min se bahar jaata hai. Bahut lambe time baad tank me kitna salt hoga?
questions.explanation: Q' = 12 − (Q/200)·4. Steady state Q' = 0 ⇒ Q = 600 g, yaani tank ka concentration inflow ke barabar 3 g/L. 12 g/min sirf inflow rate hai, total salt nahi. 800 g = 200 × 4 me flow rate ko concentration samajh liya. 66.7 g = 200/3 me multiply ki jagah divide kar diya.

questions.question: Capacitor discharge V = V₀e^(−t/τ) me t = τ par voltage V₀ ka kitna percent bachta hai?
questions.explanation: e⁻¹ ≈ 0.368, to 36.8% bachta hai. 63.2% = 1 − e⁻¹ charging ka number hai (ya discharge me jitna kho gaya). 50% half-life par hota hai, jo τ ln 2 ≈ 0.693τ par aata hai. Exponential decay finite time me 0 nahi hota.

questions.question: Ek isotope sample 3 din me 100 mg se 80 mg ho jaata hai (exponential decay). Iski half-life kitni hai?
questions.explanation: e^(−3k) = 0.8 ⇒ k = ln 1.25/3 ≈ 0.0744 per din. t½ = ln 2/k = 3 ln 2/ln 1.25 ≈ 9.32 din. 7.5 din linear soch hai (har 3 din 20 mg ghatega) — exponential me har din ek hi fraction ghatta hai, amount nahi. 13.4 din τ = 1/k hai, half-life nahi. 0.97 din me ratio ulta le liya (3 ln 1.25/ln 2).

questions.question: RC circuit (τ = 2 ms) ko DC source se charge kiya, V_c(0) = 0. V_c apni final value ka 90% kab pahunchega?
questions.explanation: V_c = V(1 − e^(−t/τ)). 0.9 = 1 − e^(−t/τ) ⇒ e^(−t/τ) = 0.1 ⇒ t = τ ln 10 = 2 × 2.303 ≈ 4.61 ms. 1.80 ms = 0.9τ, linear soch. 0.21 ms = τ ln(1/0.9), jo 10% tak pahunchne ka time hai (e^(−t/τ) = 0.9 le liya). 2.00 ms = τ par sirf 63.2% hota hai.

questions.question: Ek brake disc 20°C hawa me thanda ho raha hai (Newton's law of cooling). t = 5 min par uska temperature 60°C aur t = 10 min par 44°C hai. t = 0 par disc ka temperature kitna tha?
questions.explanation: T − 20 exponentially ghatta hai: 5 min me 40 se 24, yaani har 5 min me factor 24/40 = 0.6. Peeche jao: T(0) − 20 = 40/0.6 = 66.7 ⇒ T(0) ≈ 86.7°C. 76°C linear extrapolation hai (har 5 min 16°C) — exponential me shuru me girawat tez hoti hai. 66.7 sirf difference T − Tₐ hai, ambient 20 jodna bhool gaye. 100°C data se match nahi karta (100 → 60 me factor 0.5 hota, phir 10 min par 40°C aata).

questions.question: 2 kg ka probe neeche ki taraf 50 m/s se phenka gaya, linear drag m dv/dt = mg − bv ke saath (b = 0.5 N·s/m, g = 9.8 m/s²). t = 4 s par speed kya hai?
questions.explanation: v_t = mg/b = 39.2 m/s, τ = m/b = 4 s. Solution v = v_t + (v₀ − v_t)e^(−t/τ) = 39.2 + 10.8·e⁻¹ ≈ 39.2 + 3.97 = 43.2 m/s — speed upar se v_t ki taraf ghatti hai. 24.8 m/s formula v = v_t(1 − e^(−t/τ)) ka hai, jo v₀ = 0 maanta hai. 18.4 = 50e⁻¹ me gravity bhool gaye. 39.2 m/s maanta hai ki probe turant terminal speed par aa gaya.

questions.question: Series RL circuit: L = 2 H, R = 4 Ω, aur t = 0 par 20 V DC source joda gaya (i(0) = 0). Current 4 A kab pahunchega?
questions.explanation: i_final = V/R = 5 A, τ = L/R = 0.5 s. 4 = 5(1 − e^(−t/0.5)) ⇒ e^(−2t) = 0.2 ⇒ t = ln 5/2 ≈ 0.805 s. 0.112 s = 0.5·ln(5/4), jo e^(−2t) = 0.8 lene se aata hai (1 − wala step ulta). 3.22 s me τ = R/L = 2 s le liya. 0.400 s linear soch hai (4/5 × τ).

questions.question: 90 kg ka skydiver quadratic drag ke saath girta hai: m dv/dt = mg − cv², c = 0.3 kg/m, g = 9.8 m/s², v(0) = 0. t = v_t/g par (yaani gt/v_t = 1) speed kitni hogi?
questions.explanation: v_t = √(mg/c) = √(882/0.3) = √2940 ≈ 54.2 m/s. v(t) = v_t·tanh(gt/v_t) = 54.2 × tanh 1 ≈ 54.2 × 0.7616 ≈ 41.3 m/s. 34.3 m/s linear drag wala 1 − e⁻¹ = 63.2% factor hai — quadratic drag me tanh lagta hai. 54.2 terminal speed hai, jo sirf t → ∞ par aati hai. 27.1 = v_t/2 isse pehle (gt/v_t ≈ 0.55 par) aa chuka hota hai.

weeks.title: Second-order linear ODEs and damping
weeks.summary: Is week aap homogeneous second-order linear ODEs ki theory (superposition, Wronskian, Abel ka formula) samjhoge, characteristic equation ke teeno cases solve karoge, aur mass-spring-damper ko ωₙ aur damping ratio ζ se underdamped, critical ya overdamped classify karoge.
concepts: **Linear homogeneous second-order**: y'' + p(t)y' + q(t)y = 0. Agar y₁ aur y₂ solutions hain to c₁y₁ + c₂y₂ bhi solution hai (**superposition**). General solution ke liye do 'alag' (linearly independent) solutions chahiye, aur do initial conditions y(t₀), y'(t₀) se c₁, c₂ fix hote hain.

**Wronskian**: W(y₁, y₂) = y₁y₂' − y₂y₁'. Agar kisi point par W ≠ 0 to y₁, y₂ **fundamental set** hain (independent), aur unse har solution ban sakta hai. Jaise W(cos ωt, sin ωt) = ω ≠ 0. Agar y₂ = k·y₁ to W = 0 — ek hi solution do baar gina.

**Abel's formula**: y'' + p(t)y' + q(t)y = 0 ke kinhi bhi do solutions ka W(t) = C·e^(−∫p dt). Matlab Wronskian ya to har jagah zero hai ya kahin zero nahi — aur use nikaalne ke liye solutions jaanne ki zaroorat bhi nahi, sirf p(t) chahiye.

**Constant coefficients**: ay'' + by' + cy = 0, characteristic ar² + br + c = 0. Do real alag roots ⇒ c₁e^(r₁t) + c₂e^(r₂t). Repeated root r ⇒ (c₁ + c₂t)e^(rt) (doosra solution t·e^(rt) reduction of order se aata hai). Complex α ± iβ ⇒ e^(αt)(c₁ cos βt + c₂ sin βt).

**Mass-spring-damper**: m x'' + c x' + k x = 0 (landing gear ka shock strut, seat suspension, accelerometer ka proof mass). Divide by m: x'' + 2ζωₙx' + ωₙ²x = 0, jahan **natural frequency** ωₙ = √(k/m) aur **damping ratio** ζ = c/(2√(km)). Critical damping coefficient c_c = 2√(km), aur ζ = c/c_c.

**Damping regimes**: ζ < 1 **underdamped** — decaying oscillation, damped frequency ω_d = ωₙ√(1 − ζ²). ζ = 1 **critically damped** — sabse tez wapas aata hai bina overshoot ke. ζ > 1 **overdamped** — do real negative roots, dheere-dheere bina oscillation ke settle. ζ = 0 me pure oscillation cos ωₙt.

**Design intuition**: aircraft landing gear ya door closer ko aksar ζ ≈ 0.3–0.7 ke aas-paas rakhte hain — thoda overshoot, par jaldi settle. Measuring instruments (galvanometer, accelerometer) ke liye ζ ≈ 0.7 popular hai. Envelope e^(−ζωₙt) batata hai ki oscillation kitni jaldi marti hai.

example.problem: Ek drone ke landing leg ka model: m = 100 kg, k = 10000 N/m, c = 600 N·s/m. ωₙ, ζ, regime aur damped frequency nikalo, aur characteristic roots likho.
steps: ζ < 1 ⇒ **underdamped**: leg thoda oscillate karke settle hoga.
Real part −3 = −ζωₙ envelope deta hai: x(t) = e^(−3t)(c₁ cos 9.54t + c₂ sin 9.54t).
Answer: **ωₙ = 10 rad/s, ζ = 0.3 (underdamped), ω_d ≈ 9.54 rad/s**, roots −3 ± 9.54i.

mistakes: Repeated root par c₁e^(rt) + c₂e^(rt) likh dena. Ye asal me ek hi solution hai (W = 0). Doosra solution t·e^(rt) hai.
Complex roots α ± iβ me e^(βt) aur cos(αt) ulta lagana. Real part α decay/growth deta hai (exponent me), imaginary part β frequency deta hai (cos/sin me).
ζ nikaalte waqt c/(2km) ya c/√(km) likhna. Sahi formula ζ = c/(2√(km)) hai — dimensions check karo, ζ unitless hona chahiye.
revision: W = y₁y₂' − y₂y₁' ≠ 0 ⇒ fundamental set.
Abel: W = C·e^(−∫p dt).
Roots: real alag / repeated (t·e^(rt)) / complex e^(αt)(cos, sin).
ζ < 1 under, = 1 critical, > 1 over; ω_d = ωₙ√(1 − ζ²).

questions.question: y'' − 5y' + 6y = 0 ka general solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: Characteristic r² − 5r + 6 = (r − 2)(r − 3) = 0 ⇒ r = 2, 3, dono positive. Negative roots tab aate jab factors (r + 2)(r + 3) padh lo — yaani −5 ka sign bhool gaye. (c₁ + c₂x)e^(2x) sirf repeated root ke liye hota hai.

questions.question: y₁ = eˣ aur y₂ = x·eˣ ka Wronskian W(y₁, y₂) kya hai?
questions.explanation: y₁' = eˣ, y₂' = eˣ + xeˣ. W = eˣ(eˣ + xeˣ) − xeˣ·eˣ = e^(2x). Ye kabhi zero nahi, to dono independent hain — isliye repeated root me x·eˣ doosra solution banta hai. 0 wala trap sochta hai 'dono me eˣ hai to dependent' — par x se multiply karna constant multiple nahi hai.

questions.question: m = 2 kg, k = 50 N/m, c = 8 N·s/m wale mass-spring-damper ka damping ratio ζ aur regime kya hai?
questions.explanation: ζ = c/(2√(km)) = 8/(2√100) = 8/20 = 0.4 < 1 ⇒ underdamped (ωₙ = 5 rad/s). 0.08 = c/(2k) me √ aur m chhoot gaye. 2.5 = 1/0.4, fraction ulta. 'Overdamped' ζ < 1 ka matlab ulta padhna hai.

questions.question: m = 4 kg aur k = 100 N/m wale system ko critically damped banane ke liye damping coefficient c kitna chahiye?
questions.explanation: Critical: c² = 4km ⇒ c = 2√(km) = 2√400 = 40 N·s/m. 20 = √(km) me 2 bhool gaye. 10 = √(k/m)·2 to ωₙ jaisa number hai, damping nahi. 80 = 4√(km): c² = 4km se 4 ko bina square root liye bahar nikaal diya.

questions.question: y'' + 4y' + 13y = 0, y(0) = 1, y'(0) = 0 ka solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: r² + 4r + 13 = 0 ⇒ r = −2 ± 3i. y = e^(−2t)(c₁ cos 3t + c₂ sin 3t). y(0) = c₁ = 1. y'(0) = −2c₁ + 3c₂ = 0 ⇒ c₂ = 2/3. e^(−3t)(cos 2t ...) real aur imaginary parts ko ulta laga deta hai. c₂ = 2 tab aata hai jab y'(0) me sin ke derivative ka factor 3 bhool jao.

questions.question: t > 0 par y'' + (2/t)y' + q(t)y = 0 ke do solutions ka Wronskian W(1) = 3 hai. Abel's formula se W(2) kya hai?
questions.explanation: W = C·e^(−∫(2/t)dt) = C·e^(−2 ln t) = C/t². W(1) = 3 ⇒ C = 3, to W(2) = 3/4. 12 = 3t² me exponent ka minus sign bhool gaye. 3/2 = 3/t me ∫(2/t) ka factor 2 chhoot gaya. Dhyan do: q(t) ka answer par koi asar nahi.

questions.question: y'' + 6y' + 9y = 0 ka general solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: r² + 6r + 9 = (r + 3)² = 0 ⇒ r = −3 repeated. Repeated root par doosra solution t·e^(rt) hota hai, to (c₁ + c₂t)e^(−3t). c₁e^(−3t) + c₂e^(3t) roots ±3 maanta hai (r² − 9 = 0 wala case). (c₁ + c₂t)e^(3t) me sign galat. cos/sin tab aate jab roots complex hote — yahan discriminant 36 − 36 = 0 hai.

questions.question: Ek accelerometer ka proof mass m = 0.5 kg aur spring k = 200 N/m hai. Natural frequency ωₙ kya hai?
questions.explanation: ωₙ = √(k/m) = √(200/0.5) = √400 = 20 rad/s. 400 me square root bhool gaye. 10 = √(k·m) = √100 me ratio ki jagah product le liya. 100 = k·m me product bhi aur root bhi dono galti.

questions.question: Ek door closer ka damping ratio ζ = 1.5 hai. Darwaza chhodne par uska motion kaisa hoga?
options: Oscillate karte hue, dheere-dheere band hoga
Sabse tez, bina kisi overshoot ke band hoga
Bina ruke hamesha oscillate karta rahega
questions.explanation: ζ > 1 overdamped hai: do real negative roots, to koi oscillation nahi, aur settle hona critically damped (ζ = 1) se dheema hota hai. Decaying oscillation ζ < 1 (underdamped) ka behaviour hai. 'Sabse tez, bina overshoot' critical damping ζ = 1 hai. Hamesha oscillation sirf ζ = 0 par hota hai.

questions.question: x'' + 6x' + 25x = 0 wale system ki damped frequency ω_d kya hai?
questions.explanation: ωₙ = √25 = 5, 2ζωₙ = 6 ⇒ ζ = 0.6. ω_d = ωₙ√(1 − ζ²) = 5 × 0.8 = 4 rad/s. Roots se check: r = −3 ± 4i, imaginary part 4 ✓. 5 rad/s undamped ωₙ hai. 3 decay rate ζωₙ (real part) hai, frequency nahi. √19 me 25 − 6 kar diya — ghatana (6/2)² = 9 tha.

questions.question: y₁ = e^(2t) aur y₂ = e^(−t) ka Wronskian W(y₁, y₂) kya hai?
questions.explanation: W = y₁y₂' − y₂y₁' = e^(2t)(−e^(−t)) − e^(−t)(2e^(2t)) = −eᵗ − 2eᵗ = −3eᵗ. 3eᵗ me order ulta liya (y₂y₁' − y₁y₂'). −2eᵗ me y₁' = 2e^(2t) ka 2 bhool gaye. −eᵗ me y₂' ka minus sign chhoot gaya (eᵗ − 2eᵗ).

questions.question: y'' + 5y' + 4y = 0, y(0) = 0, y'(0) = 3 hai. y(t) apni maximum value kis t par leta hai?
questions.explanation: Roots r = −1, −4. y = c₁e^(−t) + c₂e^(−4t); y(0) = 0 ⇒ c₂ = −c₁; y'(0) = −c₁ + 4c₁ = 3c₁ = 3 ⇒ c₁ = 1, to y = e^(−t) − e^(−4t). y' = −e^(−t) + 4e^(−4t) = 0 ⇒ e^(3t) = 4 ⇒ t = (ln 4)/3 ≈ 0.462. ln 4 me roots ke fark 3 se divide nahi kiya. (ln 4)/4 aur (ln 4)/5 me galat number (bada root ya coefficient 5) se divide kiya.

questions.question: m = 2 kg, k = 8 N/m wale system me damping ratio ζ = 0.5 chahiye. Damping coefficient c aur damped frequency ω_d kya honge?
questions.explanation: ωₙ = √(8/2) = 2 rad/s, c_c = 2√(km) = 2√16 = 8, to c = ζc_c = 4 N·s/m. ω_d = 2√(1 − 0.25) = √3 ≈ 1.73 rad/s. c = 8 critical damping (ζ = 1) hai. ω_d = 2 undamped ωₙ hai. 'c = 2, ω_d = 1' me c_c ki jagah √(km) = 4 ko ζ se multiply kiya, aur ω_d ki jagah ζωₙ le liya.

questions.question: t > 0 par t²y'' + 3ty' + y = 0 ke do solutions ka Wronskian W(1) = 2 hai. W(2) kya hai?
questions.explanation: Pehle standard form: y'' + (3/t)y' + y/t² = 0, to p = 3/t. Abel: W = C·e^(−∫3/t dt) = C/t³. W(1) = 2 ⇒ C = 2 ⇒ W(2) = 2/8 = 1/4. 2e^(−9/2) tab aata hai jab t² se divide kiye bina p = 3t le lo. 16 me exponent ka sign ulta (C·t³). 1/2 me p = 2/t jaisa galat coefficient le liya (C/t²).

questions.question: Ek seat suspension: m = 50 kg, k = 5000 N/m, c = 500 N·s/m. Oscillation ka envelope e^(−ζωₙt) apni shuruaati value ke 5% tak kitne time me girega?
questions.explanation: ωₙ = √(5000/50) = 10 rad/s, ζ = 500/(2√250000) = 0.5, to decay rate ζωₙ = 5 per s (= c/(2m) ✓). e^(−5t) = 0.05 ⇒ t = ln 20/5 ≈ 0.60 s. 0.30 s me ζ bhool ke ωₙ = 10 se divide kiya. 5.99 s me ωₙ bhool ke sirf ζ = 0.5 liya. 0.35 s me ω_d ≈ 8.66 use kiya — par ω_d frequency hai, envelope real part se aata hai.

weeks.title: Forced oscillations: non-homogeneous second-order ODEs
weeks.summary: Is week aap ay'' + by' + cy = g(t) ka particular solution undetermined coefficients (modification rule ke saath) aur variation of parameters se nikaloge, aur forced mass-spring-damper me steady-state amplitude, resonance aur beats samjhoge.
concepts: **Structure**: y = y_h + y_p, jahan y_h homogeneous equation ka general solution (do constants) aur y_p koi bhi ek particular solution hai. Agar g = g₁ + g₂ to y_p = y_p1 + y_p2 — har forcing ka hissa alag nikaal ke jodo. Initial conditions hamesha poore y par lagao, sirf y_h par nahi.

**Undetermined coefficients — guess table**: g polynomial (degree n) ⇒ poora degree-n polynomial guess (saare lower terms samet). g = e^(kt) ⇒ Ae^(kt). g = cos ωt ya sin ωt ⇒ A cos ωt + B sin ωt (dono, chahe g me sirf ek ho). Products ke liye guesses ka product: t·e^(2t) ⇒ (At + B)e^(2t).

**Modification rule**: agar guess ka koi term y_h ka solution hai to guess ko t se multiply karo; agar ab bhi hai (double root) to t² se. y'' − 3y' + 2y = e^(2t) me r = 1, 2 hain, to Ae^(2t) kaam nahi karega — Ate^(2t) lo. Pehle y_h nikaalna isi liye zaroori hai.

**Variation of parameters**: jab g sec t, tan t, ln t, eᵗ/t jaisa ho (table me nahi), to y_p = u₁y₁ + u₂y₂ lo, jahan u₁' = −y₂g/W aur u₂' = y₁g/W, W = Wronskian. Shart: equation standard form y'' + py' + qy = g me ho (y'' ka coefficient 1) — warna pehle divide karo.

**Forced damped oscillator**: m x'' + c x' + k x = F₀ cos ωt. Transient (y_h) e^(−ζωₙt) se mar jaata hai; bachta hai steady state X cos(ωt − φ), jahan X = F₀/√((k − mω²)² + (cω)²) aur tan φ = cω/(k − mω²). Low ω par X ≈ F₀/k (static deflection).

**Resonance**: bina damping ke ω = ωₙ par guess y_h me hi hai, to modification rule se x_p = (F₀/(2mωₙ))·t·sin ωₙt — amplitude t ke saath linearly badhta jaata hai. Damping ho to amplitude finite rehta hai, aur peak ω_r = ωₙ√(1 − 2ζ²) par aata hai (ζ < 1/√2). Wing flutter, engine vibration aur RLC tuning sab isi ki kahani hain.

**Beats**: undamped system ko ωₙ ke kareeb (par barabar nahi) ω se force karo, x(0) = x'(0) = 0, to x ∝ cos ωt − cos ωₙt = 2 sin((ωₙ − ω)t/2)·sin((ωₙ + ω)t/2). Tez oscillation ka amplitude dheere-dheere upar-neeche hota hai — do kareebi frequencies wale propellers ki 'wah-wah' awaaz yahi hai.

example.problem: Variation of parameters se y'' + y = sec t (−π/2 < t < π/2) ka particular solution nikalo.
steps: Homogeneous: r² + 1 = 0 ⇒ y₁ = cos t, y₂ = sin t. W = cos t·cos t − sin t·(−sin t) = 1.
Equation pehle se standard form me hai, g = sec t.
u₁' = −y₂g/W = −sin t·sec t = −tan t ⇒ u₁ = ln|cos t|.
u₂' = y₁g/W = cos t·sec t = 1 ⇒ u₂ = t.
y_p = u₁y₁ + u₂y₂ = cos t·ln|cos t| + t sin t.
Check: y_p' = −sin t·ln|cos t| − sin t + sin t + t cos t = −sin t·ln|cos t| + t cos t; y_p'' = −cos t·ln|cos t| + sin²t/cos t + cos t − t sin t; y_p'' + y_p = sin²t/cos t + cos t = 1/cos t = sec t ✓.
Answer: **y_p = cos t·ln|cos t| + t sin t**, aur general solution y = c₁ cos t + c₂ sin t + y_p.

mistakes: g = 3 cos t par sirf A cos t guess karna. Damping (y' term) ho to sin bhi aata hai, isliye hamesha A cos ωt + B sin ωt lo; jahan B zero aana hai, wo calculation khud bata degi.
Modification rule bhoolna: guess y_h me ho to substitute karne par 0 = g jaisa contradiction milta hai. Ise 'no solution' mat samjho — t se multiply karo.
Variation of parameters me u₁' ka minus sign bhoolna, ya y'' ka coefficient 1 kiye bina formula lagana (2y'' + ... = g me g/2 use karna hai).
revision: y = y_h + y_p; ICs poore y par.
cos/sin forcing ⇒ A cos ωt + B sin ωt.
Guess y_h me ho ⇒ × t (double root ⇒ × t²).
u₁' = −y₂g/W, u₂' = y₁g/W.
X = F₀/√((k − mω²)² + (cω)²); undamped resonance ⇒ t sin ωₙt growth.

questions.question: y'' + 2y' + 5y = 10 ka ek particular solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: Constant guess y_p = A: y_p' = y_p'' = 0, to 5A = 10 ⇒ A = 2. 10 me y ka coefficient 5 se divide karna bhool gaye. 1/2 me fraction ulta (5/10). Constant r = 0 root nahi hai (r² + 2r + 5 = 0 ke roots −1 ± 2i), to modification ki zaroorat nahi.

questions.question: y'' − 3y' + 2y = 5e^(2t) ke liye undetermined coefficients ka sahi trial form kya hai?
questions.explanation: Characteristic r² − 3r + 2 = (r − 1)(r − 2) ⇒ r = 1, 2. e^(2t) already y_h me hai (simple root), to ek baar t se multiply: Ate^(2t). Ae^(2t) substitute karne par 0 = 5e^(2t) aata hai. t² sirf double root par lagta. (At + B)e^(2t) ka B part phir se y_h hai — bekaar.

questions.question: y'' + 4y = 3 cos t ka particular solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: y_p = A cos t + B sin t: y_p'' = −A cos t − B sin t, to (−A + 4A) cos t + 3B sin t = 3 cos t ⇒ A = 1, B = 0, y_p = cos t. (3/5) me ω² ka sign galat (4 + 1). −cos t me 3/(1 − 4) — y'' ka sign ulta le liya. y' term nahi hai, isliye B = 0 aata hai.

questions.question: Undamped system y'' + 9y = 6 sin 3t (resonance) ka particular solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: Forcing frequency 3 = ωₙ, to guess t(A cos 3t + B sin 3t). Substitute karne par −6A sin 3t + 6B cos 3t = 6 sin 3t ⇒ A = −1, B = 0 ⇒ y_p = −t cos 3t (amplitude t ke saath badhta hai). (2/3) sin 3t = 6/9 sin 3t resonance ignore karta hai — wo to y_h ka hissa hai aur 0 deta hai. t sin 3t aur −t sin 3t me cos/sin ka switch nahi hua.

questions.question: x'' + 2x' + 5x = 10 cos t ke steady-state response ka amplitude kya hai?
questions.explanation: Yahan m = 1, c = 2, k = 5, ω = 1, F₀ = 10. X = F₀/√((k − mω²)² + (cω)²) = 10/√(4² + 2²) = 10/√20 = √5 ≈ 2.24. 5/2 = 10/4 damping ignore karta hai. 2 = F₀/k static deflection hai (ω = 0 wala). 5/3 = 10/(4 + 2) me squares ka root lene ki jagah seedha jod diya.

questions.question: Variation of parameters se y'' − 2y' + y = eᵗ/t (t > 0) ka particular solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: r = 1 double root ⇒ y₁ = eᵗ, y₂ = teᵗ, W = e^(2t). u₁' = −y₂g/W = −1 ⇒ u₁ = −t; u₂' = y₁g/W = 1/t ⇒ u₂ = ln t. y_p = −teᵗ + teᵗ ln t, aur −teᵗ to y_h ka hissa hai, use chhod do ⇒ y_p = teᵗ ln t. eᵗ ln t me u₂ ko y₂ = teᵗ ki jagah eᵗ se multiply kar diya. eᵗ/t to forcing hi hai — undetermined coefficients wali 'g jaisa guess' aadat.

questions.question: y'' + y = e^(2t) ka particular solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: Guess Ae^(2t): y'' = 4Ae^(2t), to 4A + A = 1 ⇒ A = 1/5. 1/4 me y wala term bhool gaye (sirf y'' liya). 1/3 me 2² ki jagah 2 le liya (2A + A). A = 1 sirf guess hai, substitute karke check nahi kiya.

questions.question: y'' + y' + y = t² ke liye undetermined coefficients ka sahi trial form kya hai?
questions.explanation: Degree 2 polynomial forcing ke liye poora degree-2 polynomial lo, saare lower terms samet: At² + Bt + C. y' aur y'' se t aur constant terms bante hain, jo sirf At² se balance nahi honge. At³ tab chahiye jab y wala term equation me na ho aur modification lage — yahan y term hai. At² + C me t wala term chhoot gaya.

questions.question: m x'' + c x' + k x = F₀ cos ωt me F₀ = 20 N aur k = 400 N/m hai. Bahut kam frequency (ω → 0) par steady-state amplitude lagbhag kitna hoga?
questions.explanation: X = F₀/√((k − mω²)² + (cω)²), to ω → 0 par X ≈ F₀/k = 20/400 = 0.05 m (static deflection). 0.5 m aur 0.005 m decimal galtiyan hain (20/40 ya 20/4000). 20 m me k se divide karna hi bhool gaye.

questions.question: y'' + y = 3 + 2eᵗ ka particular solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: Har forcing ka hissa alag: y'' + y = 3 ke liye y_p1 = 3; y'' + y = 2eᵗ ke liye Aeᵗ: A + A = 2 ⇒ A = 1. Jodo: y_p = 3 + eᵗ. 3 + 2eᵗ me y'' se aane wala eᵗ bhool gaye (2A ki jagah A). 1 + eᵗ me constant ko 3 se divide kar diya. 3t tab chahiye hota jab constant y_h ka solution ho — yahan y_h = cos t, sin t hai.

questions.question: x'' + 2x' + 5x = 10 cos t ke steady-state response x = X cos(t − φ) me phase lag φ kya hai?
questions.explanation: tan φ = cω/(k − mω²) = 2·1/(5 − 1) = 0.5 ⇒ φ = tan⁻¹ 0.5 ≈ 26.6°. 63.4° = tan⁻¹ 2, ratio ulta le liya. 45° tab aata jab k − mω² = cω hota. 90° resonance (k = mω²) par hota hai, yahan nahi.

questions.question: y'' − 4y' + 4y = e^(2t) ka particular solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: r² − 4r + 4 = (r − 2)² ⇒ r = 2 double root, to e^(2t) aur te^(2t) dono y_h me hain. Modification rule: guess At²e^(2t). Substitute karne par sirf 2Ae^(2t) bachta hai: 2A = 1 ⇒ A = 1/2. te^(2t) ya (1/2)te^(2t) abhi bhi y_h ka solution hai — substitute karo to 0 aata hai. t²e^(2t) me A nikaalna bhool gaye (2A = 1).

questions.question: y'' + 4y = 8, y(0) = 0, y'(0) = 2 hai. y(π/2) kya hai?
questions.explanation: y_p = 2 (4A = 8). y = 2 + c₁ cos 2t + c₂ sin 2t. y(0) = 0 ⇒ c₁ = −2; y'(0) = 2c₂ = 2 ⇒ c₂ = 1. y(π/2) = 2 − 2 cos π + sin π = 2 + 2 = 4. 2 tab aata hai jab initial conditions sirf y_h par lagao (c₁ = 0) — conditions hamesha poore y par lagti hain. 16 me y_p = 8 le liya (4 se divide nahi kiya). 0 maanta hai ki y(0) wali value repeat hogi.

questions.question: Undamped system x'' + 25x = 10 cos 5t, x(0) = 0, x'(0) = 0 hai. t = 6 s par oscillation ka amplitude (envelope) kitna hai?
questions.explanation: ω = ωₙ = 5, yaani resonance. Modification rule se x_p = (F₀/(2mωₙ))·t sin 5t = (10/10) t sin 5t = t sin 5t; ye x(0) = 0 aur x'(0) = 0 dono satisfy karta hai, to x = t sin 5t. Envelope t hai, t = 6 par 6. 12 me 2 se divide bhool gaye (F₀/(mωₙ)). 1.2 me F₀/(2ωₙ²) jaisa galat factor liya. 0.4 = F₀/k static amplitude hai — resonance par amplitude constant nahi rehta, badhta jaata hai.

questions.question: x'' + 100x = 2 cos 8t, x(0) = 0, x'(0) = 0 ka solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: x_p = A cos 8t: (100 − 64)A = 2 ⇒ A = 1/18. x = (1/18) cos 8t + c₁ cos 10t + c₂ sin 10t; x(0) = 0 ⇒ c₁ = −1/18, x'(0) = 0 ⇒ c₂ = 0. To x = (1/18)(cos 8t − cos 10t) = (1/18)·2 sin t sin 9t = (1/9) sin t sin 9t — beats: tez sin 9t ka amplitude dheere sin t se badalta hai. (1/18) sin t · sin 9t me identity ka factor 2 bhool gaye. (1/18)(cos 10t − cos 8t) me c₁ ka sign ulta. sin 2t · sin 18t me sum/difference ko 2 se divide nahi kiya.

weeks.title: Vectors in 3D, lines and planes
weeks.summary: Is week aap 3D vectors ke dot aur cross product, projections, work aur torque, scalar triple product, aur space me lines aur planes ki equations aur distances seekhoge.
concepts: **3D vectors**: a = (a₁, a₂, a₃) = a₁i + a₂j + a₃k. Magnitude |a| = √(a₁² + a₂² + a₃²), unit vector â = a/|a|. Do points P, Q ke beech vector PQ = Q − P (end minus start). Force, velocity, wind aur displacement sab isi bhasha me likhe jaate hain.

**Dot product**: a·b = a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ + a₃b₃ = |a||b| cos θ. Result ek scalar hai. a·b = 0 ⇔ perpendicular, a·b > 0 ⇒ acute angle, < 0 ⇒ obtuse. **Work** W = F·d — sirf force ka wo hissa kaam karta hai jo displacement ki direction me hai.

**Projection**: b ki direction me a ka scalar component comp_b a = (a·b)/|b|, aur vector projection proj_b a = ((a·b)/|b|²)·b. Aircraft par lift aur drag isi tarah resolve hote hain — relative wind ki direction me component drag, perpendicular lift.

**Cross product**: a × b = (a₂b₃ − a₃b₂, a₃b₁ − a₁b₃, a₁b₂ − a₂b₁), determinant se yaad rakho. Ye a aur b dono ke perpendicular hai (right-hand rule), |a × b| = |a||b| sin θ = parallelogram ka area. b × a = −(a × b). **Torque** τ = r × F — bolt ya control surface hinge par moment.
**Scalar triple product**: a·(b × c) = 3×3 determinant jiski rows a, b, c hain. |a·(b × c)| = parallelepiped ka volume. Zero ho to teeno vectors **coplanar** hain — ek hi plane me.

**Lines in 3D**: point r₀ aur direction v se r(t) = r₀ + t·v, yaani x = x₀ + at, y = y₀ + bt, z = z₀ + ct. Symmetric form (x − x₀)/a = (y − y₀)/b = (z − z₀)/c. Do lines parallel (v multiples), intersecting, ya **skew** (na parallel, na milti) ho sakti hain — 3D me teesra case naya hai.

**Planes**: normal n = (a, b, c) aur point P₀ se a(x − x₀) + b(y − y₀) + c(z − z₀) = 0, yaani ax + by + cz = d. Teen points diye hon to do edge vectors ka cross product normal deta hai. Point (x₁, y₁, z₁) se plane ki distance = |ax₁ + by₁ + cz₁ − d|/√(a² + b² + c²). Do planes ka angle unke normals ka angle hai.

example.problem: Points P(1, 0, 2), Q(2, 1, 0) aur R(0, 3, 1) se guzarne wale plane ki equation nikalo.
steps: Edge vectors: PQ = Q − P = (1, 1, −2), PR = R − P = (−1, 3, −1).
Simplify: 5x + 3y + 4z = 5 + 8 = 13.

mistakes: Cross product ke middle component ka sign galat lena. Determinant se karo to j wale term me minus aata hai: −(a₁b₃ − a₃b₁) = a₃b₁ − a₁b₃ — formula ko component-by-component check karo.
Scalar projection aur vector projection mix karna: (a·b)/|b| ek number hai, (a·b)/|b|² × b ek vector. Aur b par projection me |b| se divide karo, |a| se nahi.
Point-to-plane distance me plane ko ax + by + cz = d form me laaye bina constant galat lena, ya √(a² + b² + c²) se divide karna bhool jaana.
revision: a·b = |a||b| cos θ; a·b = 0 ⇔ perpendicular.
|a × b| = area; a × b ⊥ a, b; b × a = −a × b.
comp_b a = (a·b)/|b|.
a·(b × c) = 0 ⇔ coplanar.
Plane: n·(r − r₀) = 0; distance |ax₁ + by₁ + cz₁ − d|/|n|.

questions.question: a = (1, 1, 0) aur b = (0, 1, 1) ke beech ka angle kya hai?
questions.explanation: a·b = 0 + 1 + 0 = 1, |a| = |b| = √2, to cos θ = 1/2 ⇒ θ = 60°. 90° tab sochte hain jab lagta hai 'alag axes par hain' — par dono ka y-component common hai. 45° me |a||b| = 2 ki jagah √2 le liya (cos θ = 1/√2).

questions.question: Ek drone par constant force F = (3, −2, 5) N lagta hai jab wo (1, 0, 0) m se (4, 2, 1) m tak jaata hai. Force ne kitna work kiya?
questions.explanation: d = (4, 2, 1) − (1, 0, 0) = (3, 2, 1). W = F·d = 9 − 4 + 5 = 10 J. 18 J me −2·2 ka minus sign ignore kiya. 13 J = F·(4, 2, 1) me displacement ki jagah end point se dot kar diya — hamesha pehle d = end − start nikaalo.

questions.question: (1, 2, 3) × (4, 5, 6) kya hai?
questions.explanation: (2·6 − 3·5, 3·4 − 1·6, 1·5 − 2·4) = (12 − 15, 12 − 6, 5 − 8) = (−3, 6, −3). Check: (−3, 6, −3)·(1, 2, 3) = −3 + 12 − 9 = 0 ✓. (3, −6, 3) to b × a hai (order ulta). (−3, −6, −3) me middle component ka sign galat. (4, 10, 18) component-wise product hai, cross product nahi.

questions.question: a = (3, 4, 0) ka b = (1, 2, 2) ki direction me scalar component (comp_b a) kya hai?
questions.explanation: a·b = 3 + 8 + 0 = 11, |b| = √(1 + 4 + 4) = 3, to comp_b a = 11/3. 11/9 = (a·b)/|b|² vector projection ka coefficient hai, component nahi. 11/5 me |a| = 5 se divide kiya — wo b ka a par component hai.

questions.question: Point (1, 2, 3) ki plane 2x − y + 2z = 10 se distance kya hai?
questions.explanation: |2·1 − 2 + 2·3 − 10|/√(4 + 1 + 4) = |−4|/3 = 4/3. 4 me |n| = 3 se divide karna bhool gaye. 4/9 me |n|² se divide kiya. 2 = 6/3 me plane ka constant 10 ghatana bhool gaye.

questions.question: k ki kis value par vectors (1, 2, k), (2, 0, 1) aur (0, 1, 3) coplanar hain?
questions.explanation: Coplanar ⇔ scalar triple product = 0. Determinant = 1(0·3 − 1·1) − 2(2·3 − 1·0) + k(2·1 − 0·0) = −1 − 12 + 2k. 2k − 13 = 0 ⇒ k = 13/2. −11/2 tab aata hai jab doosre term ka minus (cofactor sign) bhool jao: −1 + 12 + 2k = 0. 13 me 2k ka 2 chhoot gaya.

questions.question: Wind ka direction vector a = (2, −1, 2) hai. Is direction me unit vector kya hai?
questions.explanation: |a| = √(4 + 1 + 4) = 3, to â = a/3 = (2/3, −1/3, 2/3). /9 me |a|² se divide kar diya. /5 me √(2² + 1² + 2²) ki jagah 2 + 1 + 2 jod diye. (1, −1/2, 1) me sabse bade component 2 se divide kiya — iski length 1.5 hai, 1 nahi.

questions.question: Inme se kaunsa vector (1, 2, −1) ke perpendicular hai?
questions.explanation: Perpendicular ⇔ dot product 0. (3, −1, 1)·(1, 2, −1) = 3 − 2 − 1 = 0 ✓. (1, 1, 1) se 1 + 2 − 1 = 2, (2, 1, 0) se 2 + 2 = 4, (0, 1, 1) se 2 − 1 = 1 — koi zero nahi. Teesre component ka −1 sign dhyan me rakhna hi yahan trap hai.

questions.question: Plane 3x − 2y + z = 7 ka ek normal vector kya hai?
questions.explanation: ax + by + cz = d me normal (a, b, c) hota hai, to (3, −2, 1). Constant 7 sirf plane ki position batata hai, direction nahi, isliye (3, −2, 7) aur (−2, 1, 7) galat. (3, 2, 1) me y ka minus sign chhoot gaya.

questions.question: Ek solar panel triangle ke vertices (0, 0, 0), (1, 2, 0) aur (3, 0, 1) par hain. Triangle ka area kya hai?
questions.explanation: Edge vectors u = (1, 2, 0), v = (3, 0, 1). u × v = (2·1 − 0·0, 0·3 − 1·1, 1·0 − 2·3) = (2, −1, −6), |u × v| = √(4 + 1 + 36) = √41. Triangle = parallelogram ka aadha = √41/2 ≈ 3.20. √41 poora parallelogram hai. 41/2 me square root bhool gaye. √50/2 = |u||v|/2 me sin θ hi bhool gaye.

questions.question: Ek drone (1, 2, 3) se (3, 1, 5) ki taraf seedhi line me chalta hai; line dono taraf badhai gayi hai. Ye line plane z = 0 ko kahan kaatti hai?
Ek control-surface hinge se r = (0.5, 0, 0) m door force F = (0, 20, 10) N lagta hai. Torque τ = r × F aur |τ| kya hain?
questions.explanation: r × F = (0·10 − 0·20, 0·0 − 0.5·10, 0.5·20 − 0·0) = (0, −5, 10). |τ| = √(25 + 100) = √125 ≈ 11.2 N·m. (0, 5, 10) me middle component ka sign galat (a₃b₁ − a₁b₃ ka order). (0, 5, −10) asal me F × r hai — cross product me order badalne se sign palat jaata hai. 15 me components jod diye; magnitude ke liye squares ke sum ka root chahiye.

questions.question: Line L₁: (1, 0, 0) + t(1, 1, 0) aur line L₂: (0, 1, 1) + s(0, 1, 1) hai. Inka aapas me relation kya hai?
options: Skew: na parallel, na kahin milti
questions.explanation: Directions (1, 1, 0) aur (0, 1, 1) ek doosre ke multiple nahi ⇒ parallel nahi. Milne ke liye: 1 + t = 0, t = 1 + s, 0 = 1 + s. Pehli se t = −1, doosri se s = −2, par teesri s = −1 maangti hai — contradiction, to milti nahi ⇒ skew. (0, −1, 0) L₁ par hai (t = −1), par L₂ par nahi (s = −2 par z = −1). 'Parallel' ya 'ek hi line' ke liye directions multiples hone chahiye.

questions.question: Planes x + y + z = 1 aur x − y + 2z = 4 ke beech ka angle kya hai?
questions.explanation: Normals n₁ = (1, 1, 1), n₂ = (1, −1, 2). n₁·n₂ = 1 − 1 + 2 = 2, |n₁| = √3, |n₂| = √6. cos θ = 2/√18 ≈ 0.471 ⇒ θ ≈ 61.9°. 28.1° = 90° − 61.9°, cos ki jagah sin wala angle le liya. 90° tab hota jab dot product 0 hota. 19.5° me −1 ka sign bhool ke dot = 4 le liya.

questions.question: Planes x + y + z = 6 aur x − y + z = 2 ki intersection line kaunsi hai?
questions.explanation: Direction dono normals ke perpendicular: (1, 1, 1) × (1, −1, 1) = (2, 0, −2) ∝ (1, 0, −1). Equations ghatane se 2y = 4 ⇒ y = 2, aur x + z = 4; (2, 2, 2) dono planes par hai ✓. (1, 1, 1) normal hai, line ki direction nahi. (4, 2, 0) aur (1, 2, 3) dono planes par hain, par direction (1, 0, 1) ya (2, 0, 2) galat — cross product ke z component ka sign ulta ho gaya.

weeks.title: Vector-valued functions and motion along curves
weeks.summary: Is week aap space curves ko r(t) se describe karoge, velocity, speed aur acceleration nikaloge, acceleration integrate karke trajectory banaoge, arc length nikaloge, aur curvature se samjhoge ki curve kitna tez mudta hai.
concepts: **Vector-valued function**: r(t) = (x(t), y(t), z(t)) har time t par ek point deta hai — jaise ek aircraft ya satellite ka path. Limit, continuity aur derivative sab component-wise: r'(t) = (x'(t), y'(t), z'(t)).

**Velocity, speed, acceleration**: v(t) = r'(t) curve ka tangent vector hai, speed = |v(t)| (scalar), aur a(t) = r''(t). Unit tangent T = v/|v|. Speed constant ho tab bhi acceleration zero nahi hota agar direction badal rahi ho — circular motion me a center ki taraf hota hai.

**Differentiation rules**: (u·v)' = u'·v + u·v' aur (u × v)' = u' × v + u × v' (cross product me order mat badlo). Ek useful result: agar |r(t)| constant hai (jaise circle ya sphere par motion) to r·r' = 0, yaani velocity position ke perpendicular hai.

**Integrate karke trajectory**: a(t) diya ho to v(t) = v(0) + ∫a dt, r(t) = r(0) + ∫v dt. Constant gravity a = (0, 0, −g) ke saath r(t) = r₀ + v₀t + (0, 0, −gt²/2) — projectile ya air-dropped payload ka path. Har integration me ek vector constant aata hai, initial conditions se fix karo.
**Arc length**: t = a se b tak curve ki length L = ∫ₐᵇ |r'(t)| dt = ∫ √(x'² + y'² + z'²) dt. Helix (R cos t, R sin t, ct) ki speed constant √(R² + c²) hai, to ek chakkar ki length 2π√(R² + c²).

**Curvature**: κ batata hai curve direction kitni tezi se badalta hai. κ = |r' × r''|/|r'|³. Plane curve y = f(x) ke liye κ = |f''|/(1 + f'²)^(3/2). Radius R ke circle ki κ = 1/R, aur **radius of curvature** ρ = 1/κ. Straight line ki κ = 0.

**Acceleration ke components**: a = a_T·T + a_N·N, jahan a_T = d|v|/dt (speed badalne se) aur a_N = κ|v|² (direction badalne se). Constant speed par turn karta aircraft sirf a_N = v²/ρ mehsoos karta hai — yahi pilot par 'g-load' banata hai.

example.problem: Ek climbing turn me aircraft ka path helix r(t) = (3 cos t, 3 sin t, 4t) hai (units km, t minutes). Speed, ek poore chakkar (0 ≤ t ≤ 2π) ki arc length, aur curvature nikalo.
steps: r'(t) = (−3 sin t, 3 cos t, 4). Speed = √(9 sin²t + 9 cos²t + 16) = √25 = 5 (constant).
Arc length = ∫₀^(2π) 5 dt = 10π ≈ 31.4 km.
