r''(t) = (−3 cos t, −3 sin t, 0).
r' × r'' = (3 cos t·0 − 4·(−3 sin t), 4·(−3 cos t) − (−3 sin t)·0, (−3 sin t)(−3 sin t) − (3 cos t)(−3 cos t)) = (12 sin t, −12 cos t, 9).
κ = 15/125 = 3/25 = 0.12 per km (general formula R/(R² + c²) = 3/25 ✓), radius of curvature ρ = 25/3 ≈ 8.33 km.
Answer: **speed 5, arc length 10π, κ = 3/25** — climb ki wajah se curvature flat circle (κ = 1/3) se kam hai.

mistakes: Speed aur velocity mix karna: velocity ek vector hai (r'), speed uska magnitude |r'|. 'Speed kya hai' poochha ho to vector likhna galat hai.
Arc length me ∫|r'| dt ki jagah |∫r' dt| (displacement ki length) nikaal dena. Curve ghoom ke wapas aaye to displacement zero ho sakta hai, par length nahi.
Curvature ko |r''| samajh lena. |r''| tabhi κ deta hai jab speed 1 ho; warna |r' × r''|/|r'|³ use karo.
revision: v = r', speed = |r'|, a = r''.
r(t) = r₀ + v₀t + ∫∫a.
Circle: κ = 1/R; a_N = κ|v|².

questions.question: r(t) = (t², 2t, t³) ke liye t = 1 par speed kya hai?
questions.explanation: r'(t) = (2t, 2, 3t²), t = 1 par (2, 2, 3). Speed = √(4 + 4 + 9) = √17. 17 me square root lena bhool gaye. 7 = 2 + 2 + 3 components ko seedha jod diya. √13 = √(4 + 9) me y-component 2 bhool gaye.

questions.question: r(t) = (cos 2t, sin 2t, t) ka acceleration a(t) kya hai?
questions.explanation: r' = (−2 sin 2t, 2 cos 2t, 1), r'' = (−4 cos 2t, −4 sin 2t, 0). Ye xy-plane me center (z-axis) ki taraf point karta hai. (−2 sin 2t, 2 cos 2t, 1) sirf velocity hai. (4 cos 2t, ...) me sign galat (bahar ki taraf). (−cos 2t, ...) me chain rule ka 2² = 4 bhool gaye.

questions.question: Curve r(t) = (2t, t², ln t) ki 1 ≤ t ≤ e par arc length kya hai?
questions.explanation: r' = (2, 2t, 1/t), |r'|² = 4 + 4t² + 1/t² = (2t + 1/t)², to |r'| = 2t + 1/t. L = [t² + ln t]₁^e = (e² + 1) − (1 + 0) = e². e² + 1 me lower limit ka t² = 1 ghatana bhool gaye. e² − 1 me ln e = 1 jodna bhool gaye.

questions.question: Parabola y = x² ka point (1, 1) par radius of curvature kya hai?
questions.explanation: f' = 2x = 2, f'' = 2. κ = 2/(1 + 4)^(3/2) = 2/(5√5) ≈ 0.179, to radius ρ = 1/κ = 5√5/2 ≈ 5.59. 2/(5√5) curvature hai, radius nahi — yahi sabse common trap. 1/2 aur 2 origin wali values hain (wahan f' = 0), (1, 1) ki nahi.

questions.question: Ek payload ka acceleration a(t) = (0, 0, −10) m/s² hai, v(0) = (20, 0, 30) m/s aur r(0) = (0, 0, 0). t = 2 s par position kya hai?
questions.explanation: v(t) = (20, 0, 30 − 10t), r(t) = (20t, 0, 30t − 5t²). t = 2: (40, 0, 60 − 20) = (40, 0, 40). (40, 0, 80) me gravity ka sign ulta (+5t²). (40, 0, 60) me gravity hi bhool gaye. (20, 0, 10) to t = 2 par velocity hai.

questions.question: Helix r(t) = (4 cos t, 4 sin t, 3t) ki curvature κ kya hai?
questions.explanation: r' = (−4 sin t, 4 cos t, 3), |r'| = 5. r'' = (−4 cos t, −4 sin t, 0). r' × r'' = (12 sin t, −12 cos t, 16), magnitude √(144 + 256) = 20. κ = 20/125 = 4/25. 1/4 radius 4 wale flat circle ki curvature hai — climb (3t) ko ignore kiya. 3/25 me R aur c ki jagah badal di. 1/5 = 1/|r'| sirf speed ka ulta hai.

questions.question: r(t) = (3t, t², 5) ke liye t = 2 par velocity vector aur speed kya hain?
questions.explanation: v = r' = (3, 2t, 0) ⇒ t = 2 par (3, 4, 0), speed √(9 + 16) = 5. (6, 4, 5) to position r(2) hai, velocity nahi. (3, 4, 5) me constant 5 ka derivative 0 lena bhool gaye. (3, 2, 0) me t = 2 rakhna bhool gaye (2t ko 2 likh diya).

questions.question: Radius 4 km ke circular holding pattern me udte aircraft ke path ki curvature κ kya hai?
questions.explanation: Radius R ke circle ki κ = 1/R = 1/4 per km. 4 radius of curvature ρ hai, κ nahi. 1/16 = 1/R² me galat power. 0 sirf straight line ki curvature hai.

questions.question: r(t) = (t, 2t, 2t) ka unit tangent vector T kya hai?
questions.explanation: v = (1, 2, 2), |v| = √(1 + 4 + 4) = 3, T = v/|v| = (1/3, 2/3, 2/3). (1, 2, 2) unit nahi hai (length 3). /5 me squares ke bina 1 + 2 + 2 jod diya. /9 me |v|² se divide kiya.

questions.question: Ek satellite circular orbit me hai, to uska position hamesha |r(t)| = 7000 km rehta hai. r(t)·r'(t) kya hai?
options: Orbit ki speed par depend karta hai
questions.explanation: r·r = 7000² constant hai. Differentiate: 2 r·r' = 0 ⇒ r·r' = 0 — velocity hamesha position ke perpendicular hai. 7000² to r·r hai, uska derivative nahi. 7000·|r'| tab hota jab r aur r' parallel hote. Speed kuch bhi ho, r·r' zero hi rehta hai.

questions.question: Plane curve r(t) = (t², t³) ki 0 ≤ t ≤ 1 par arc length kya hai?
questions.explanation: r' = (2t, 3t²), |r'| = √(4t² + 9t⁴) = t√(4 + 9t²). u = 4 + 9t² se ∫₀¹ t√(4 + 9t²) dt = (1/27)[(4 + 9t²)^(3/2)]₀¹ = (13√13 − 8)/27 ≈ 1.44. √2 sirf (0, 0) se (1, 1) ka seedha displacement hai — curve usse thoda lamba hai. 13√13/27 me lower limit (t = 0 par 4^(3/2) = 8) bhool gaye. /18 me substitution ka factor galat liya (sahi 1/18 × 2/3 = 1/27).

questions.question: Ek particle r(t) = (t, t²) par chalta hai. t = 1 par acceleration ke tangential aur normal components a_T, a_N kya hain?
questions.explanation: v = (1, 2t) = (1, 2), |v| = √5, a = (0, 2). a_T = d|v|/dt = v·a/|v| = 4/√5 ≈ 1.79. a_N = √(|a|² − a_T²) = √(4 − 16/5) = 2/√5 ≈ 0.89 (ya κ|v|² se, κ = 2/5^(3/2)). a_T aur a_N ko swap karna common galti hai. 'a_T = 2, a_N = 0' poore a ko tangential maan leta hai, jabki path mud raha hai. a_N = 2 me |a| ko hi normal component le liya.

questions.question: Ek aircraft ka path y = x²/4000 (metres) hai aur wo constant speed 200 m/s se udta hai. Lowest point (x = 0) par acceleration ka magnitude kya hai?
questions.explanation: x = 0 par y' = x/2000 = 0 aur y'' = 1/2000, to κ = |y''|/(1 + y'²)^(3/2) = 1/2000 per m, ρ = 2000 m. Speed constant ⇒ a_T = 0, aur a_N = κv² = 40000/2000 = 20 m/s² (lagbhag 2g). 0.1 = v/ρ me v² ki jagah v le liya. 40 me y'' galat 1/1000 le liya (x²/4000 ko do baar differentiate karne par 2/4000 aata hai). '0' galat — speed constant hai par direction badal rahi hai.

questions.question: Ek rocket sled ka acceleration a(t) = (6t, 2, 0) m/s² hai, v(0) = (0, 1, 0) m/s aur r(0) = (1, 0, 0) m. t = 2 s par position kya hai?
questions.explanation: v = v(0) + ∫a dt = (3t², 2t + 1, 0). r = r(0) + ∫v dt = (1 + t³, t² + t, 0). t = 2: (9, 6, 0). (8, 6, 0) me r(0) jodna bhool gaye. (9, 4, 0) me v(0) bhool gaye. (24, 4, 0) me a·t²/2 lagaya, jo sirf constant acceleration par sahi hai — yahan a t ke saath badal raha hai.

questions.question: Twisted cubic r(t) = (t, t², t³) ki t = 1 par curvature κ kya hai?

weeks.title: Partial derivatives, gradient and tangent planes
weeks.summary: Is week aap do ya teen variables ke functions ke level curves, limits aur continuity samjhoge, partial derivatives aur multivariable chain rule lagaoge, gradient se directional derivative aur steepest direction nikaloge, aur tangent plane se linear approximation karoge.
concepts: **Functions of several variables**: z = f(x, y) ek surface hai; T(x, y, z) jaisa function space ke har point ko ek number deta hai (temperature, pressure, potential). **Level curves** f(x, y) = c contour map banate hain — weather map ke isobars aur PCB par equipotential lines isi ke examples hain.

**Limits aur two-path test**: (x, y) → (a, b) har direction aur har raaste se ho sakta hai. Agar do raaston par limit alag aaye to limit exist nahi karti. Jaise xy/(x² + y²) line y = mx par m/(1 + m²) deta hai — m par depend karta hai, to (0, 0) par limit nahi. Continuity ka matlab limit = function value.

**Partial derivatives**: f_x = ∂f/∂x me y ko constant maan ke x me differentiate karo; f_y me ulta. Geometrically f_x surface ka slope hai x-direction me. Second partials f_xx, f_yy, f_xy; agar ye continuous hain to **Clairaut**: f_xy = f_yx.

**Chain rule**: z = f(x, y), x = x(t), y = y(t) ⇒ dz/dt = f_x·dx/dt + f_y·dy/dt. Har raasta (tree diagram ki branch) ka contribution jodo. Engineering me: power P = V²/R jab V aur R dono time ke saath badal rahe hon, to dP/dt dono ke effects ka sum hai.

**Gradient**: ∇f = (f_x, f_y, f_z). Ye wo direction hai jisme f sabse tez badhta hai, aur us direction me rate |∇f| hai. −∇f sabse tez ghatne ki direction (heat isi taraf behti hai). ∇f level curve/surface ke **perpendicular** hota hai.

**Directional derivative**: unit vector u ki direction me rate D_u f = ∇f·u = |∇f| cos θ. Direction vector unit na ho to pehle normalise karo. Max value |∇f| (θ = 0), min −|∇f|, aur level curve ke along (θ = 90°) zero.

**Tangent plane aur linearisation**: z = f(a, b) + f_x(a, b)(x − a) + f_y(a, b)(y − b). Point ke paas f ≈ ye plane. Differential dz = f_x dx + f_y dy se measurement error propagate hota hai: V = πr²h me relative error dV/V = 2 dr/r + dh/h — radius ka error do guna asar karta hai.

example.problem: f(x, y) = x²y + 3xy² ka point (1, 2) par vector (3, 4) ki direction me directional derivative nikalo. Is point par maximum rate of increase kitna hai?
steps: Direction ko unit banao: |(3, 4)| = 5 ⇒ u = (3/5, 4/5).
Maximum rate = |∇f| = √(256 + 169) = √425 ≈ 20.6, direction (16, 13) ki taraf.
Answer: **D_u f = 20**, aur max rate **√425 ≈ 20.6** — (3, 4) direction gradient ke kaafi kareeb hai, isliye 20 max ke paas hai.

mistakes: Directional derivative me direction vector ko normalise na karna. ∇f·(3, 4) = 100 aata, jo 5 guna bada hai — u hamesha unit vector hona chahiye.
Do-teen raaston par limit same aane se maan lena ki limit exist karti hai. Same aana sirf hint hai; proof ke liye squeeze ya polar coordinates chahiye. Alag aaye to pakka exist nahi karti.
Partial derivative me doosre variable ko constant na maanna: ∂(x²y)/∂x = 2xy, 2xy + x² nahi.
revision: f_x: y constant; f_xy = f_yx (Clairaut).
dz/dt = f_x x' + f_y y'.
D_u f = ∇f·u, u unit vector.
Max rate |∇f| direction ∇f me; ∇f ⊥ level curve.
Tangent plane: z = f + f_x(x − a) + f_y(y − b).

questions.question: f(x, y) = x³y² + sin(xy) ke liye ∂f/∂x kya hai?
questions.explanation: y constant: ∂(x³y²)/∂x = 3x²y², ∂ sin(xy)/∂x = cos(xy)·y (chain rule). 3x²y² + cos(xy) me inner derivative y chhoot gaya. 2x³y + x cos(xy) to ∂f/∂y hai. Minus sign tab aata hai jab sin ka derivative −cos samajh lo.

questions.question: lim (x, y) → (0, 0) of xy/(x² + y²) kya hai?
questions.explanation: y = 0 ke along value 0 hai, par y = x ke along x²/(2x²) = 1/2. Do raaston par alag limits ⇒ limit exist nahi karti. 0 sirf axes ke along check karne se aata hai; 1/2 sirf y = x wala raasta dekhta hai.

questions.question: Ek heater me P = V²/R hai. Kisi pal V = 12 V hai aur 0.1 V/s se ghat raha hai, aur R = 6 Ω hai jo garam hone se 0.2 Ω/s se badh raha hai. Us pal dP/dt kya hai?
questions.explanation: P_V = 2V/R = 24/6 = 4, P_R = −V²/R² = −144/36 = −4. dP/dt = 4·(−0.1) + (−4)·(0.2) = −0.4 − 0.8 = −1.2 W/s. −0.4 sirf V ka effect hai aur −0.8 sirf R ka — chain rule me dono jodne hain. 0.4 tab aata hai jab P_R ka minus sign bhool jao.

questions.question: f(x, y) = 3x² − xy ka point (1, 2) par vector (4, 3) ki direction me directional derivative kya hai?
questions.explanation: f_x = 6x − y = 4, f_y = −x = −1, to ∇f = (4, −1). u = (4, 3)/5 = (0.8, 0.6). D_u f = 3.2 − 0.6 = 2.6. 13 = ∇f·(4, 3) me normalise karna bhool gaye. √17 = |∇f| maximum rate hai, is direction ka nahi. 3.8 me f_y ka minus sign chhoot gaya.

questions.question: Surface z = x² + 2y² ka point (1, 1, 3) par tangent plane kya hai?
questions.explanation: f_x = 2x = 2, f_y = 4y = 4. z = 3 + 2(x − 1) + 4(y − 1) = 2x + 4y − 3. Check: (1, 1) par 2 + 4 − 3 = 3 ✓. z = 2x + 4y + 3 me (x − 1), (y − 1) ki jagah x, y le liye. z = 2x + 4y point se nahi guzarta (6 ≠ 3).

questions.question: Ek plate par temperature T(x, y) = 100 − x² − 2y² hai. Point (2, 1) par T kis unit direction me sabse tezi se badhta hai, aur kis rate se?
questions.explanation: ∇T = (−2x, −4y) = (−4, −4) at (2, 1). Direction ∇T/|∇T| = (−1/√2, −1/√2), aur rate |∇T| = √32 = 4√2 ≈ 5.66 — garam center (0, 0) ki taraf. (1/√2, 1/√2) sabse tez thanda hone ki direction hai (−∇T). Rate 8 me components ko seedha jod diya; (−4, −4) unit vector nahi hai aur 32 = |∇T|² hai.

questions.question: f(x, y) = x²·e^(3y) ke liye ∂f/∂y kya hai?
questions.explanation: x² ko constant maano: ∂/∂y e^(3y) = 3e^(3y), to f_y = 3x²e^(3y). 2xe^(3y) to ∂f/∂x hai. x²e^(3y) me chain rule ka 3 bhool gaye. 6xe^(3y) mixed partial f_xy hai.

questions.question: f(x, y, z) = x² + y² + z² ka point (1, −1, 2) par gradient kya hai?
questions.explanation: ∇f = (2x, 2y, 2z) ⇒ (2, −2, 4). (1, −1, 2) me factor 2 bhool gaye. (2, 2, 4) me y ka sign chhoot gaya. 6 to f ki value hai — gradient ek vector hota hai, number nahi.

questions.question: f(x, y) = x³y² ke liye f_xy kya hai?
questions.explanation: f_x = 3x²y², phir y me differentiate: f_xy = 6x²y (Clairaut se f_yx bhi same: f_y = 2x³y, f_yx = 6x²y ✓). 6xy² to f_xx hai. 3x²y² sirf f_x hai, aur 2x³y sirf f_y.

questions.question: f(x, y) = x² + y² ka point (3, 4) par unit vector u = (−4/5, 3/5) ki direction me directional derivative kya hai?
questions.explanation: ∇f = (2x, 2y) = (6, 8). D_u f = 6(−4/5) + 8(3/5) = −24/5 + 24/5 = 0. Ye u gradient ke perpendicular hai, yaani level circle x² + y² = 25 ke tangent ke along — wahan f nahi badalta. 10 = |∇f| sirf gradient direction me max rate hai, aur −10 ulti direction me min. 48/5 me −4/5 ka minus sign chhoot gaya.

questions.question: f(x, y) = √(x² + y²) ko (3, 4) par linearise karke f(3.06, 3.92) ka estimate kya aata hai?
questions.explanation: f(3, 4) = 5, f_x = x/f = 3/5, f_y = y/f = 4/5. dx = 0.06, dy = −0.08 ⇒ f ≈ 5 + 0.6(0.06) + 0.8(−0.08) = 5 + 0.036 − 0.064 = 4.972 (exact ≈ 4.9729 ✓). 5.000 me f_x aur f_y swap ho gaye. 5.028 me dx aur dy ke signs ulte le liye. 4.980 me dono partials ko 1 maan liya.

questions.question: Heater ki power P = V²/R hai. V ke measurement me ±1% aur R me ±2% tak error ho sakta hai. Differentials se P ka maximum possible relative error kitna hai?
questions.explanation: ln P = 2 ln V − ln R ⇒ dP/P = 2 dV/V − dR/R. Worst case me dono errors ek hi taraf dhakelte hain (V +1%, R −2%): |dP/P| ≤ 2(1%) + 2% = 4%. 0% tab aata hai jab 2(1%) − 2% karke signs cancel maan lo — par maximum error me magnitudes judte hain. 3% me V² ka power 2 bhool gaye. 2% sirf R ka error hai.

questions.question: z = x²y + y³, jahan x = cos t aur y = sin t. t = π/4 par dz/dt kya hai?
questions.explanation: z_x = 2xy, z_y = x² + 3y². t = π/4 par x = y = √2/2: z_x = 1, z_y = 1/2 + 3/2 = 2. dx/dt = −sin t = −√2/2, dy/dt = cos t = √2/2. dz/dt = 1·(−√2/2) + 2·(√2/2) = √2/2. 3√2/2 me dx/dt ka minus sign chhoot gaya. −√2/2 me z_x aur z_y aapas me badal gaye. 2 me sirf z_y le liya, dy/dt se multiply karna aur x wali branch dono bhool gaye.

questions.question: Sphere x² + y² + z² = 9 ka point (1, 2, 2) par tangent plane kya hai?
questions.explanation: F = x² + y² + z² ka ∇F = (2, 4, 4) level surface ke perpendicular hai, to normal (1, 2, 2). Plane: 1(x − 1) + 2(y − 2) + 2(z − 2) = 0 ⇒ x + 2y + 2z = 9 (check: 1 + 4 + 4 = 9 ✓). '= 0' wala plane origin se guzarta hai, point (1, 2, 2) se nahi. 2x + 4y + 4z = 9 me normal sahi hai par constant 18 hona chahiye tha. x + y + z = 5 me normal galat liya (bas coordinates ka sum).

questions.question: f(x, y) = x²y/(x⁴ + y²) ke liye har line y = mx par (0, 0) ki taraf limit 0 aati hai. lim (x, y) → (0, 0) f ke baare me kya sahi hai?
options: Exist karti hai aur 0 hai, har line par 0
Exist nahi karti; x-axis par limit ∞ hai
Exist nahi karti; y = x² par limit 1/2 hai
questions.explanation: Line y = mx: x²·mx/(x⁴ + m²x²) = mx/(x² + m²) → 0. Par parabola y = x² par x⁴/(x⁴ + x⁴) = 1/2. Do raaston par alag values ⇒ limit exist nahi karti. 'Har line par 0' kaafi nahi — lines sirf kuch raaste hain. 1/2 bhi limit nahi, sirf ek raaste ki value hai. x-axis (y = 0) par f = 0 hai, ∞ nahi.

weeks.title: Optimisation and double integrals
weeks.summary: Is week aap do variables ke functions ke critical points ko second-derivative test se classify karoge, constraint ke saath Lagrange multipliers se optimise karoge, aur double integrals ko iterated integrals, order badal ke, aur polar coordinates me nikaloge.
concepts: **Critical points**: f(x, y) ke local max/min wahan ho sakte hain jahan ∇f = 0 (f_x = 0 aur f_y = 0 ek saath) ya jahan partials exist nahi karte. Dono equations ko simultaneous solve karo — ek me se variable nikaal ke doosri me daalo.

**Second-derivative test**: D = f_xx·f_yy − (f_xy)² critical point par. D > 0 aur f_xx > 0 ⇒ local minimum; D > 0 aur f_xx < 0 ⇒ local maximum; D < 0 ⇒ **saddle point** (ek direction me upar, doosri me neeche — jaise ghode ki kaathi); D = 0 ⇒ test chup, aur dekhna padega.

**Absolute extrema on closed region**: closed aur bounded region par continuous f ka absolute max aur min zaroor hota hai. Recipe: andar ke critical points par f nikaalo, boundary ko parametrise karke single-variable problem solve karo, corners bhi check karo, aur sab values me sabse badi/chhoti chuno.

**Lagrange multipliers**: f(x, y) ko constraint g(x, y) = k par optimise karna ho to ∇f = λ∇g aur g = k ek saath solve karo. Geometry: optimum par f ka level curve constraint curve ko chhoota (tangent) hai, isliye dono ke gradients parallel. λ batata hai ki constraint k thoda badhane par optimum value kitni badlegi.

**Double integral aur Fubini**: ∬_R f dA ko iterated integral ki tarah nikaalte hain: ∫ₐᵇ ∫_c^d f(x, y) dy dx — andar wala pehle (doosra variable constant). Rectangle par order badalne se answer same rehta hai. f ≥ 0 ho to ye surface ke neeche ka volume hai; f = 1 lo to region ka area.

**Non-rectangular regions aur order badalna**: region y = g₁(x) se g₂(x) tak ho to andar ki limits x par depend karti hain. Kabhi ek order me integral impossible lagta hai (jaise ∫ e^(y²) dy), par region ka sketch bana ke order badalne par aasaan ho jaata hai. Limits hamesha region ke diagram se nikaalo, purane integral ko ulat ke nahi.

**Polar coordinates**: x = r cos θ, y = r sin θ, aur **dA = r dr dθ** (extra r mat bhoolo). Circle, disk, ring ya sector wale regions aur x² + y² wale integrands ke liye polar sabse aasaan. Jaise antenna dish ya circular plate par load/mass ka total.

example.problem: f(x, y) = x³ + y³ − 3xy ke critical points nikalo aur classify karo.
steps: f_x = 3x² − 3y = 0 ⇒ y = x². f_y = 3y² − 3x = 0 ⇒ x = y².
y = x² ko doosri me rakho: x = x⁴ ⇒ x(x³ − 1) = 0 ⇒ x = 0 ya x = 1. Critical points (0, 0) aur (1, 1).
Second partials: f_xx = 6x, f_yy = 6y, f_xy = −3. To D = 36xy − 9.
(0, 0): D = −9 < 0 ⇒ **saddle point**.
Answer: **(0, 0) saddle, (1, 1) local minimum with value −1**.

mistakes: D me (f_xy)² ki jagah f_xy likh dena, ya f_xx aur f_yy dono positive dekh ke seedha minimum bol dena. f = x² + 3xy + y² me f_xx = f_yy = 2 > 0 hai, par D = 4 − 9 < 0 ⇒ saddle.
Polar me dA = dr dθ likhna. Jacobian r bhoolne se disk ka area πR² ki jagah 2πR aata hai — units se bhi pakad sakte ho.
Order badalte waqt purani limits ko bas swap kar dena. ∫₀¹∫ₓ¹ ... dy dx ka order badal ke ∫₀¹∫₀^y ... dx dy hota hai — region sketch karke hi pata chalta hai.
revision: Critical: f_x = f_y = 0.
D = f_xx f_yy − f_xy²: D > 0 min/max (sign of f_xx), D < 0 saddle.
Lagrange: ∇f = λ∇g, g = k.
Fubini: inner integral pehle; limits region se.
Polar: dA = r dr dθ.

questions.question: ∫₀¹ ∫₀² (x + y) dy dx ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: Andar: ∫₀² (x + y) dy = [xy + y²/2]₀² = 2x + 2. Bahar: ∫₀¹ (2x + 2) dx = 1 + 2 = 3. 2 sirf rectangle ka area hai — integrand ignore ho gaya. 4 tab aata hai jab ∫₀¹ 2x dx = 1 ki jagah 2 le lo. Order badal ke bhi 3 hi aata hai — rectangle par Fubini.

questions.question: f(x, y) = x² + y² − 4x + 6y ka critical point aur uska type kya hai?
questions.explanation: f_x = 2x − 4 = 0 ⇒ x = 2; f_y = 2y + 6 = 0 ⇒ y = −3. f_xx = 2, f_yy = 2, f_xy = 0 ⇒ D = 4 > 0, f_xx > 0 ⇒ minimum. (Complete the square: (x − 2)² + (y + 3)² − 13.) (−2, 3) me dono signs ulte; (2, 3) me y wala sign.

questions.question: f(x, y) = x² + 3xy + y² ka origin par critical point kis type ka hai?
questions.explanation: f_xx = 2, f_yy = 2, f_xy = 3. D = 2·2 − 3² = 4 − 9 = −5 < 0 ⇒ saddle. Check: y = −x par f = x² − 3x² + x² = −x² < 0, par y = 0 par f = x² > 0 — origin na max hai na min. 'Local minimum' sirf f_xx, f_yy > 0 dekh ke cross term ko ignore karta hai.

questions.question: Disk x² + y² ≤ 4 par ∬ (x² + y²) dA ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: Polar: ∫₀^(2π) ∫₀² r²·r dr dθ = 2π·[r⁴/4]₀² = 2π·4 = 8π. 16π/3 = 2π·∫₀² r² dr tab aata hai jab dA ka extra r bhool jao. 4π disk ka area hai, integrand ka nahi. 32π = 2π·2⁴ me r⁴/4 ka 1/4 bhool gaye.

questions.question: Ek rectangular antenna ground plane ke teen sides par 20 m fencing lagani hai (chautha side wall hai), yaani x + 2y = 20. Lagrange multipliers se area A = xy ka maximum kya hai?
questions.explanation: ∇A = λ∇g: (y, x) = λ(1, 2) ⇒ y = λ, x = 2λ. Constraint: x + 2y = 2λ + 2λ = 4λ = 20 ⇒ λ = 5, x = 10, y = 5, A = 50 m². 100 m² tab aata hai jab constraint ko x + y = 20 samjho (10 × 10). 400/9 m² square (x = y = 20/3) maan lene se aata hai — jo yahan optimal nahi.

questions.question: Integration ka order badal ke ∫₀¹ ∫ₓ¹ e^(y²) dy dx ki value nikalo.
questions.explanation: Region: 0 ≤ x ≤ y, 0 ≤ y ≤ 1. Order badal ke ∫₀¹ ∫₀^y e^(y²) dx dy = ∫₀¹ y·e^(y²) dy = [e^(y²)/2]₀¹ = (e − 1)/2 ≈ 0.859. e − 1 me 1/2 bhool gaye. e/2 me lower limit e⁰/2 = 1/2 ghatana bhool gaye. Original order me e^(y²) ka elementary antiderivative hi nahi hai — isiliye order badalna padta hai.

questions.question: Ek critical point par f_xx = 2, f_yy = 2 aur f_xy = 3 hai. Ye point kis type ka hai?
questions.explanation: D = f_xx f_yy − (f_xy)² = 4 − 9 = −5 < 0 ⇒ saddle point. f_xx aur f_yy dono positive dekh ke minimum bolna classic trap hai — pehle D ka sign dekho. Maximum ke liye D > 0 aur f_xx < 0 chahiye. Inconclusive sirf D = 0 par hota hai.

questions.question: ∫₀¹ ∫₀ˣ dy dx ki value kya hai (ye kis region ka area hai)?
questions.explanation: Andar: ∫₀ˣ dy = x. Bahar: ∫₀¹ x dx = 1/2 — triangle 0 ≤ y ≤ x, 0 ≤ x ≤ 1 ka area. 1 poore unit square ka area hai (andar ki limit x ko 1 maan liya). 1/3 me galti se ∫ x² dx kar diya. 2 me 1/2 ko ulta kar diya.

questions.question: Polar coordinates me radius 3 wali disk ka area ∫₀^(2π) ∫₀³ r dr dθ kya hai?
questions.explanation: ∫₀³ r dr = 9/2, phir ∫₀^(2π) dθ = 2π ⇒ (9/2)(2π) = 9π = πR² ✓. 6π dA = dr dθ (r bhool ke) lene se aata hai — ye circumference 2πR jaisa hai, area nahi. 3π me ∫₀³ r dr ko 3/2 le liya. 18π me r²/2 ka 1/2 bhool gaye.

questions.question: f(x, y) = 4xy − x⁴ − y⁴ ka critical point (1, 1) kis type ka hai, aur wahan f ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: f_x = 4y − 4x³, f_y = 4x − 4y³ dono (1, 1) par 0 ✓. f_xx = −12x² = −12, f_yy = −12, f_xy = 4 ⇒ D = 144 − 16 = 128 > 0 aur f_xx < 0 ⇒ local maximum, f(1, 1) = 4 − 1 − 1 = 2. 'Minimum' f_xx ka sign ignore karta hai. Saddle ke liye D < 0 chahiye. 6 me x⁴, y⁴ ghatane ki jagah jod diye.

questions.question: Triangle D: 0 ≤ x ≤ 1, 0 ≤ y ≤ x par ∬_D xy dA kya hai?
questions.explanation: ∫₀¹ ∫₀ˣ xy dy dx = ∫₀¹ x·(x²/2) dx = ∫₀¹ x³/2 dx = 1/8. 1/4 poore square [0, 1]² ka answer hai (upper limit x ki jagah 1). 1/6 = ∫₀¹ x²/2 dx me bahar wala x multiply karna bhool gaye. 1/3 = ∬_D x dA me y hi bhool gaye.

questions.question: Circle x² + y² = 5 par f(x, y) = x + 2y ka maximum Lagrange multipliers se nikalo.
questions.explanation: ∇f = (1, 2) = λ(2x, 2y) ⇒ x = 1/(2λ), y = 1/λ ⇒ y = 2x. Constraint: x² + 4x² = 5 ⇒ x = ±1. (1, 2) par f = 5 (max), (−1, −2) par −5 (min). −5 minimum hai, maximum nahi. (2, 1) circle par hai par wahan gradients parallel nahi (f = 4 < 5). √5 circle ka radius hai — f ki value point rakh ke nikaalo: 1 + 4 = 5.

questions.question: f(x, y) = x² − 2x + y² ka closed disk x² + y² ≤ 4 par absolute maximum aur minimum kya hain?
questions.explanation: Andar: f_x = 2x − 2 = 0, f_y = 2y = 0 ⇒ (1, 0), f = −1. Boundary par y² = 4 − x² ⇒ f = 4 − 2x, −2 ≤ x ≤ 2: max x = −2 par 8, min x = 2 par 0. Sab compare karo: max 8 at (−2, 0), min −1 at (1, 0). 'Min 0' andar ka critical point bhool jaata hai. 'Max 0' boundary ko galat direction me padhta hai. (0, ±2) par f = 4, jo max nahi.

questions.question: Unit disk x² + y² ≤ 1 par ∬ e^(−(x² + y²)) dA kya hai?
questions.explanation: Polar: ∫₀^(2π) ∫₀¹ e^(−r²) r dr dθ. u = r² se ∫₀¹ e^(−r²) r dr = (1/2)(1 − e⁻¹). 2π se multiply ⇒ π(1 − 1/e) ≈ 1.99. 2π(1 − 1/e) me substitution ka 1/2 bhool gaye. (π/2)(1 − 1/e) me θ ki range π le li. π/e me integrand ko har jagah boundary value e⁻¹ maan ke area π se multiply kar diya.

questions.question: Ek patli plate y = x² aur y = x ke beech (0 ≤ x ≤ 1) hai, aur uski density δ(x, y) = x hai. Plate ka mass kya hai?
questions.explanation: Is region me x² ≤ x, to y ki limits x² se x tak. Mass = ∫₀¹ ∫ x dy dx (y: x² → x) = ∫₀¹ x(x − x²) dx = 1/3 − 1/4 = 1/12. 1/6 region ka area hai (density bhool gaye). −1/12 me y ki limits ulti le li (x se x²). 1/15 me density y le li: ∫₀¹ (x² − x⁴)/2 dx.

weeks.title: Triple integrals, line integrals, divergence, curl and Green's theorem
weeks.summary: Is week aap triple integrals se volume aur mass nikaloge, line integral se force field ka work calculate karoge, conservative fields aur potential pehchaanoge, divergence aur curl ka physical matlab samjhoge, aur Green's theorem se closed-curve integrals ko area integrals me badloge.
concepts: **Triple integrals**: ∭_E f dV, iterated ∫∫∫ ki tarah, andar se bahar. f = 1 ⇒ volume, f = density ρ ⇒ mass. Cylindrical coordinates me **dV = r dr dθ dz**, spherical me **dV = ρ² sin φ dρ dφ dθ** — fuel tank, rocket nozzle ya spherical pressure vessel jaise shapes ke liye ye aasaan padte hain.
**Scalar line integral**: curve C ko r(t), a ≤ t ≤ b se parametrise karo; ∫_C f ds = ∫ₐᵇ f(r(t))·|r'(t)| dt. f = 1 ho to curve ki length, f = linear density ho to ek patle wire ya cable ka mass.

**Work = vector line integral**: force field F ka C ke along work W = ∫_C F·dr = ∫ₐᵇ F(r(t))·r'(t) dt. Component form me ∫ P dx + Q dy + R dz. Curve ki direction ulti karo to sign ulta. Generally answer raaste par depend karta hai — same endpoints, alag path, alag work.

**Conservative fields**: agar F = ∇φ (φ = **potential function**), to ∫_C F·dr = φ(B) − φ(A) — sirf endpoints matter karte hain, aur har closed loop par work zero. 2D me test: ∂Q/∂x = ∂P/∂y (simply connected region par). Gravity aur electrostatic field conservative hain; isi liye potential energy aur voltage define ho paate hain.

**Divergence**: ∇·F = ∂P/∂x + ∂Q/∂y + ∂R/∂z, ek scalar. Positive ⇒ point se field bahar nikal raha hai (source), negative ⇒ sink. Incompressible flow (hawa kam speed par, paani) me ∇·v = 0. Electrostatics me ∇·E charge density se juda hai.

**Curl**: ∇×F = (R_y − Q_z, P_z − R_x, Q_x − P_y), ek vector jo batata hai field point ke aas-paas kitna ghoom raha hai (vorticity). Rigid rotation v = ω(−y, x, 0) ka curl (0, 0, 2ω) hai. Har gradient ka curl zero: ∇×(∇φ) = 0, isliye curl ≠ 0 ⇒ conservative nahi.

**Green's theorem**: simple closed curve C (anticlockwise, region D baayein haath par) ke liye ∮_C P dx + Q dy = ∬_D (∂Q/∂x − ∂P/∂y) dA. Mushkil boundary integral ko aasaan area integral me badal deta hai. Special case: area = (1/2)∮(x dy − y dx) — planimeter isi se map par area naapta hai.

example.problem: F = (x² − y, x + y²) ka circle x² + y² = 4 (anticlockwise) ke around circulation ∮ F·dr Green's theorem se nikalo.
steps: P = x² − y, Q = x + y². C closed hai aur anticlockwise, to Green lagta hai.
∮ F·dr = ∬_D 2 dA = 2 × (disk ka area) = 2 × π·2² = 8π.
Note: x² aur y² wale hisse ka koi contribution nahi — (x², y²) conservative hai (potential x³/3 + y³/3).
Direct check (parametrise r = (2 cos t, 2 sin t)) bhi 8π ≈ 25.13 deta hai.
Answer: **∮ F·dr = 8π**.

mistakes: Green's theorem me P_y − Q_x likh dena (ulta). Sahi order: ∂Q/∂x − ∂P/∂y. Curve clockwise ho to answer ka sign bhi ulta karo.
Har field ko conservative maan ke sirf endpoints se work nikaalna. Pehle curl test (Q_x = P_y) check karo; fail ho to parametrise karke poora integral karo.
Cylindrical/spherical me Jacobian bhoolna: dV = dr dθ dz nahi, r dr dθ dz; aur spherical me ρ² sin φ.
revision: dV: r dr dθ dz (cylindrical), ρ² sin φ dρ dφ dθ (spherical).
W = ∫ F(r(t))·r'(t) dt.
F = ∇φ ⇒ ∫ F·dr = φ(B) − φ(A); test Q_x = P_y.
div = P_x + Q_y + R_z; curl = (R_y − Q_z, P_z − R_x, Q_x − P_y).
Green: ∮ P dx + Q dy = ∬ (Q_x − P_y) dA, anticlockwise.

questions.question: F = (x²y, yz, xz²) ka divergence ∇·F kya hai?
questions.explanation: ∂(x²y)/∂x = 2xy, ∂(yz)/∂y = z, ∂(xz²)/∂z = 2xz. Sum = 2xy + z + 2xz. (2xy, z, 2xz) vector likh diya — divergence scalar hota hai, terms jodo. 2xy + y + 2z me galat variables ke saath differentiate kiya.

questions.question: Rotating flow F = (−y, x, 0) ka curl ∇×F kya hai?
questions.explanation: Sirf k-component bachta hai: Q_x − P_y = ∂x/∂x − ∂(−y)/∂y = 1 − (−1) = 2. (0, 0, 1) me sirf Q_x = 1 liya, −P_y wala hissa bhool gaye. (0, 0, −2) me order ulta (P_y − Q_x). (0, 0, 0) wo field hai jo ghoomta nahi — ye to rigid rotation hai, angular speed 1.

questions.question: Force field F = (y, x) (0, 0) se (2, 3) tak kisi bhi raaste par kitna work karta hai?
questions.explanation: Q_x = 1 = P_y, to F conservative hai, potential φ = xy (φ_x = y, φ_y = x). Work = φ(2, 3) − φ(0, 0) = 6. 0 sirf closed loop par hota hai. 5 = 2 + 3 aur 13 = 2² + 3² endpoints ke coordinates se bana guess hai, potential se nahi.

questions.question: Box 0 ≤ x ≤ 1, 0 ≤ y ≤ 2, 0 ≤ z ≤ 3 par ∭ xyz dV ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: Integrand aur limits alag-alag hain, to product: (∫₀¹ x dx)(∫₀² y dy)(∫₀³ z dz) = (1/2)(2)(9/2) = 9/2. 6 box ka volume hai (integrand ignore). 36 = (xyz ka max 6) × volume 6 — integrand ko constant maan liya.

questions.question: Green's theorem se ∮_C (3y dx + 5x dy) nikalo, jahan C unit circle hai (anticlockwise).
questions.explanation: P = 3y, Q = 5x ⇒ Q_x − P_y = 5 − 3 = 2. ∬ 2 dA = 2 × π·1² = 2π. 8π me 5 aur 3 ko jod diya. −2π order ulta (P_y − Q_x) lene se ya clockwise maan lene se aata hai. π sirf area hai.

questions.question: F = (y², x) ka parabola y = x² ke along (0, 0) se (1, 1) tak work ∫ F·dr kya hai?
questions.explanation: r(t) = (t, t²), r' = (1, 2t), F = (t⁴, t). F·r' = t⁴ + 2t², ∫₀¹ = 1/5 + 2/3 = 13/15. 5/6 straight line y = x ka answer hai (1/3 + 1/2) — path independence maan liya, par Q_x − P_y = 1 − 2y ≠ 0, to F conservative nahi aur raasta matter karta hai. 1 = φ(1, 1) tab aata hai jab galti se φ = xy ko potential maan lo.

questions.question: Ek fuel tank cylinder hai: radius 3 m, height 2 m. Cylindrical coordinates me ∫₀² ∫₀^(2π) ∫₀³ r dr dθ dz se volume kya aata hai?
questions.explanation: ∫₀³ r dr = 9/2, phir × 2π × 2 = 18π m³ (= πR²h ✓). 12π me Jacobian r bhool gaye (∫₀³ dr = 3). 9π me height 2 se multiply karna bhool gaye. 36π me r²/2 ka 1/2 bhool gaye.

questions.question: Field F = (2x, 2y) ke baare me kya sahi hai?
questions.explanation: ∂Q/∂x = 0 = ∂P/∂y, aur φ = x² + y² ka ∇φ = (2x, 2y) ✓. φ = 2x + 2y ka gradient (2, 2) hai — components ko hi potential maan liya. Curl (Q_x − P_y) yahan 0 hai, to 'conservative nahi' galat. ∇(x²y²) = (2xy², 2x²y), jo F se match nahi karta.

questions.question: Air-flow field v = (3x, −y, 2z) ka divergence kya hai?
questions.explanation: ∇·v = ∂(3x)/∂x + ∂(−y)/∂y + ∂(2z)/∂z = 3 − 1 + 2 = 4 (positive ⇒ source jaisa). 6 me −1 ka sign bhool gaye. (3, −1, 2) partials ka vector hai — divergence ek scalar hai, inka sum lo. 0 incompressible flow ka hota, yahan nahi.

questions.question: Ek cable (0, 0) se (3, 4) tak seedhi hai, aur uski linear density f(x, y) = x kg/m hai. ∫_C f ds se cable ka mass kya hai?
questions.explanation: r(t) = (3t, 4t), 0 ≤ t ≤ 1, |r'| = 5. ∫₀¹ 3t·5 dt = 15/2 = 7.5 kg. 1.5 me |r'| = 5 bhool gaye (ds = dt maan liya). 15 me t²/2 ka 1/2 bhool gaye. 4.5 = ∫₀³ x dx, yaani x-axis par projection ke along integrate kiya, curve ke along nahi.

questions.question: F = (2xy + 1, x² + 3y²) conservative hai. (0, 0) se (1, 2) tak F ka work kitna hai?
questions.explanation: Check: ∂Q/∂x = 2x = ∂P/∂y ✓. Potential φ = x²y + x + y³ (φ_x = 2xy + 1, φ_y = x² + 3y²). Work = φ(1, 2) − φ(0, 0) = 2 + 1 + 8 = 11. 10 me P ka '+1' (yaani x wala term) bhool gaye. 13 me x²y do baar gin liya (∫P dx + ∫Q dy wala trap). −11 me φ(A) − φ(B) kar diya, order ulta.

questions.question: Green's theorem ke area formula A = (1/2)∮(x dy − y dx) se ellipse x = 3 cos t, y = 2 sin t (0 ≤ t ≤ 2π) ka area kya hai?
questions.explanation: x dy − y dx = 3 cos t·2 cos t dt − 2 sin t·(−3 sin t) dt = 6(cos²t + sin²t) dt = 6 dt. A = (1/2)·6·2π = 6π (= πab ✓). 12π me 1/2 bhool gaye. 3π me t ki range 2π ki jagah π le li. 5π me semi-axes jod diye (π(a + b)).

questions.question: C square 0 ≤ x ≤ 2, 0 ≤ y ≤ 2 ki boundary hai (anticlockwise). Green's theorem se ∮_C (xy dx + x² dy) kya hai?
questions.explanation: P = xy, Q = x² ⇒ ∂Q/∂x − ∂P/∂y = 2x − x = x. ∬ x dA = ∫₀² ∫₀² x dy dx = 2 × 2 = 4. 8 me ∂P/∂y ghatana bhool gaye (∬ 2x dA). −4 me order ulta (P_y − Q_x). 0 tab aata jab field ko conservative maan lo — par yahan Q_x ≠ P_y.

questions.question: Radius 2 m ki solid ball ki density δ = (center se distance) kg/m³ hai. Spherical coordinates se ball ka mass kya hai?
questions.explanation: Mass = ∫₀^(2π) ∫₀^π ∫₀² ρ·ρ² sin φ dρ dφ dθ = [ρ⁴/4]₀² · [−cos φ]₀^π · 2π = 4 · 2 · 2π = 16π kg. 8π me Jacobian ka ρ² bhool gaye (∫₀² ρ dρ = 2). 8π² me sin φ bhool gaye (∫₀^π dφ = π). 32π/3 sirf volume hai (density 1 maan li).

questions.question: F = (y, −x) ka parabola y = x² ke along (0, 0) se (1, 1) tak work ∫ F·dr kya hai?
questions.explanation: r(t) = (t, t²), r' = (1, 2t), F(r(t)) = (t², −t). F·r' = t² − 2t² = −t², ∫₀¹ −t² dt = −1/3. 0 tab aata hai jab straight line y = x par karo ya field ko conservative maan lo — par curl Q_x − P_y = −2 ≠ 0, to raasta matter karta hai. 1/3 me sign galat. −1/6 me dy = 2t dt ki jagah dt le liya.
